title: Hiring Video Editor(s) for Fast-Growing DTC Health Brand!
description:
We are hiring video editor(s) for a fast-growing DTC health brand.



This is for someone who can create clean, high-retention, performance-focused video ads across short-form, UGC-style ads, Reels/TikTok content, VSL-style creatives, landing page videos, and other ecommerce creative formats.



Experienced ecommerce/direct-response editors are highly preferred, but if you are a killer editor with strong taste, speed, and hunger, you should still apply.



We can train the ecommerce/direct-response side if you already have strong editing fundamentals.



What's in it for you:

- Competitive pay based on skill, experience, and output.

- Consistent long-term remote work.

- We accept applicants worldwide.

- Full-time Monday-Friday roles available.

- Weekend coverage roles also available.

- Clear direction, references, examples, and briefs, especially in the beginning.

- Zero micromanagement if the work is high-quality and delivered on time.

- Work with a fast-moving DTC team.

- Opportunity to learn direct-response ecommerce creative.

- Strong performers can grow into higher-paid roles like Senior Editor, Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead.



This is not a dead-end editing role. The best editor on the team can grow into a Lead Editor role and eventually help manage other editors. More ownership means more opportunity.



What you'll work on:

- Short-form ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta, and other paid/social platforms.

- UGC-style video ads.

- VSL-style creatives.

- Product-focused videos.

- Hook variations and cutdowns.

- AI-assisted assets, B-roll, animations, graphics, and visual enhancements.

- Ecommerce ad creatives built around pacing, clarity, retention, and storytelling.



What we're looking for:

- Strong video editing skills.

- Strong sense of pacing, retention, captions, visual rhythm, and storytelling.

- You understand TikTok, Reels, Shorts, UGC, and modern social content.

- You can follow direction closely and match the style/vibe of provided references.

- You can work fast without making sloppy mistakes.

- You have good English comprehension and understand the nuance/vibe of scripts.

- You are comfortable using AI tools or willing to learn them fast.

- You are reliable, responsive, and can hit deadlines.

- You are coachable and hungry to improve.



Big bonus points:

- You have edited ecommerce, DTC, health, or performance-marketing videos before.

- You understand direct-response creative.

- You have worked with 7-9 figure brands before.

- You have edited ads that performed well.

- You can explain why a hook, cut, caption, or pacing choice worked.

- You have experience with VSLs, YouTube editing, creator content, or high-retention long-form editing.

- You want to grow into a Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead role.



Important:

We do not care about flashy transitions just for the sake of looking fancy.



We care about edits that make people stop scrolling, keep watching, understand the message, trust the product, and take action.



Async screening:

We do not do intro calls for the first screen.



You will write a short breakdown in this form. Bonus points if you also include a voice-note link. Double bonus points if you include a short video walkthrough link.



How to apply:

Fill out the form below.

Apply here:

tally.so/r/gDzE1J



Include your best work, any ecommerce/direct-response/ad examples if you have them, a short written breakdown of why an edit/ad worked, optional voice/video breakdown links, what types of videos you are strongest at, your tools/software, your availability, and why you are the best person for this role.



At the end of the form, write LFG so we know you actually read this.

title: Virtual Assistant — Warm Leads Caller & Appointment Setter RP Insurance Group | Remote (Philippines)
description:
Virtual Assistant — Outbound Caller & Appointment Setter

Remote (Philippines) | Full-Time | Life Insurance



About the Role:

8AM-3PM CT or 3PM-9PM CT



We are a fast-growing life insurance agency based in Illinois looking for a driven, fluent English-speaking VA to join our team. Your job is straightforward — call people who already have life insurance, introduce them to a better option, and either book them for a review call with our agent or transfer them live.



Every person you dial already has an existing life insurance policy. You are not selling from scratch. You are having a simple conversation: their current policy costs more and offers less — we can switch them to a better carrier with lower premiums and added benefits. Your job is to get them on the phone with our agent so they can see that for themselves.

This is a warm outbound role. No cold prospecting. No selling. Just real conversations that lead to appointments and transfers.



Schedule

8:00 AM – 3:00 PM CST (Central Standard Time) OR 3:00PM - 9:00PM CST (Central Standard Time), Monday through Friday. We are flexible with hours as long as you hit KPI's. You must be logged in and actively dialing during the hours. CST is night shift Philippines time — please confirm you can fully commit to this schedule before applying. Every morning starts with a team training session before dialing begins.



What You'll Do 



- Call warm leads using our GoHighLevel power dialer — these people already have life insurance and are open to reviewing their options

- Follow our proven script to introduce the consolidation opportunity and book a review appointment or transfer live

- Warm transfer hot leads directly to our agent when they are ready to talk immediately

- Log every call with accurate notes and dispositions in GoHighLevel immediately after every call

- Drop pre-recorded voi
s on no-answers with one click

- Send confirmation texts to booked leads directly from GoHighLevel

- Hit a minimum of 150 dials per day

- Attend the daily morning training session — this is mandatory, not optional

- Submit your end-of-day report every day by 5PM CST: dials, contacts, appointments booked, live transfers sent





Systems We Use



- GoHighLevel (GHL) — CRM, power dialer, calendar, and messaging. You will live in this system all day

- WhatsApp — team communication, morning check-ins, and daily accountability

- Google Sheets — end-of-day report tracking



Full training provided on all systems before your first live dial day.



Requirements



- Fluent, neutral-accent English — non-negotiable. You will speak to Americans all day every day

- Prior outbound calling experience — insurance, appointment setting, BPO, or call center background on US campaigns required

- Experience in insurance specifically is a strong advantage — life insurance, health insurance, final expense, or any related product

- Minimum 25 Mbps internet, wired connection strongly preferred

- Own laptop or desktop — no tablets, no Chromebooks

- Quiet, dedicated home office — zero background noise

- Fully available and committed to CST business hours including Saturdays

- Coachable, consistent, and resilient — you will hear no regularly and it cannot affect your energy





Compensation



- Base: $100 a week + $25 per close. (YOU WILL AVERAGE 7 CLOSES A WEEK FROM US) 

- Performance bonus: $25 per tracked sale — every time a lead you booked or transferred results in a closed policy, you earn $25. All sales have to be tracked in GoHighLevel so everything is transparent.

- Weekly streak bonus: $50 extra if you hit 5+ tracked sales in a single week

- Monthly bonuses 

- Paid bi-weekly

- 30-day performance review — strong performers receive a base pay increase and first access to expanded hours and responsibilities





To Apply

- Record a 1–2 minute voice memo introducing yourself and walking us through your outbound calling experience. Tell us what campaigns you worked, your average daily dial volume, and why you are the right fit for this role.

- Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. No exceptions.

- Include your resume and your available start date. We are hiring immediately — qualified candidates hear back within 48 hours.

We're an 8-figure DTC pet brand on a mission to become the #1 player in our space. We help dog owners take care of their dog's teeth fresher breath, cleaner teeth, fewer expensive vet bills down the line. We went from zero to eight figures in two years. We are nowhere near done.



-> The opportunity (the part most job posts won't tell you)



Right now, our ads run almost entirely on static images and advertorials. We're about to build our video-ad engine from scratch and we're hiring the editor who'll be at the center of it.



This is not "one more editor on a faceless team." You'll work directly with the founder. You'll be the person turning our scripts into winning video ads. And if you're as good as you think you are, the path is wide open: editor ? creative strategist ? CMO. We promote from obsession, not tenure.



-> What you'll actually do



- Take our VSL ad briefs and turn them into finished, scroll-stopping video ads — at volume (think one 3-minute VSL a day).

- Use and build AI Systems (not only for video generation) + obviously use basic ai software like Veo, Seedance, Kling, HeyGen, Arcads, ElevenLabs...etc

- Run feedback loops on what wins and what flops

- Communicate constantly. Take real ownership.



-> Who we're looking for



1. Obsession. You think about the work when you're not working. You want to win — for the bonuses, for the climb, for the craft. We don't care which, as long as it's real.

2. Communicate, communicate, communicate. You give feedback, you debate, you stand your ground — even with the founder. If you'll prove the CEO wrong to make a better ad, we want you.

3. Accountability. Ad flopped? Your first instinct is *"I probably messed up — let me run a feedback loop and find out why,"* not excuses.

4. Self-starter. You move without being chased. You don't need a manager standing over you.



-> Requirements



- You've worked with 7, 8, or 9-figure DTC or supplement brands. (and can provide proof)

- You are an AI geek.

- Your English is fluent and clear enough to debate ideas with us. (Accent doesn't matter. Articulating your thinking does.)

- You're fast — a 3-minute VSL is a one-day job for you, not a one-week project.



-> How to apply



Send us 2 things. If something is missing we won't review your application.



1. A personalized 1-minute Loom — you, your experience, the brands you've worked with, and what you genuinely crush.

2. A link to YOUR portfolio. (we will REJECT your application if we find ads that are not yours in your portfolio)



-> How hiring works



1. A 15-minute interview.

2. A short video assessment.

3. Onboarding



We move fast for the right person.



-> Compensation



$2,500/month base, plus performance bonuses. 

Good work = good pay + bonuses

This position serves as the primary administrative liaison between sellers & agents, ensuring every listing is processed accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional client service. You will be managing over 100 Listings. This is a fast paced high volume position. Long term opportunity. 



The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple deadlines while maintaining a superior client experience.

mbers, and administrative staff.

* Process Management

title: Amazon FBA Used Book Sourcing - Remote Requisitions Contractor
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION



A US-based company is seeking Remote Requisition Contractors based in the Philippines to source, analyze, and, when authorized, purchase used books for resale through Amazon FBA.



This is not a general VA role and not a training opportunity. This is a specialized buying and analysis engagement requiring strong attention to detail, accurate Keepa interpretation, sound purchasing judgement, and the ability to follow detailed sourcing criteria.



Contractors will help identify used books available on the Amazon marketplace that may be profitably resold through Amazon FBA. Standard purchase criteria are based on projected ROI, projected profit, and expected turnover.





CONTRACT STRUCTURE



This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employee position. Contractor is responsible for managing their own work methods, tools, hardware, internet access, taxes, and time.



The selection process is multi-stage:

- Application

- Written evaluation covering sourcing concepts, theory, and Keepa interpretation

- Onboarding

- Paid trial period

- Paid sourcing evaluation period

- Ongoing contractor engagement with potential bonus eligibility





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Source used books from the Amazon marketplace

- Interpret Keepa charts to estimate demand, price behavior, offer-count trends, and sales likelihood

- Determine whether a book meets assigned ROI, profit, and turnover objectives

- Use sourcing and analysis tools such as Keepa, BookMine, BooksRun Counterfeit Book Checker, SellerAmp, and Google Sheets

- Check current inventory before making sourcing decisions

- Log sourcing and purchase details accurately in Google Sheets

- Follow assigned sourcing objectives, spending limits, and purchase authority limits

- Maintain accurate time tracking through Jibble

- Communicate clearly through WhatsApp when needed





REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Strong English reading and writing ability

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to interpret Keepa data and/or demonstrated ability to learn advanced sourcing analysis independently

- Comfortable using Google Sheets

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Computer suitable for sourcing work

- Willingness to use Jibble for time tracking

- Willingness to communicate through WhatsApp

- Willingness to submit invoices in USD and receive payment through Wise

- Valid government-issued photo ID and clearance





PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Prior experience sourcing used books for resale on Amazon

- Prior experience using Keepa Product Finder or Keepa Deals

- Prior experience with SellerAmp, BookMine, FlipMine, Zen Arbitrage, Tactical Arbitrage, or similar sourcing tools

- Understanding of Amazon FBA, used book pricing, sales rank, offer count, buy box behavior, and seasonal book demand

- Experience working in performance-based sourcing or online arbitrage roles





TOOLS AND ACCESS



- Contractors are required to use their own Keepa Premium subscription. (Subscription reimbursement is available to eligible contractors.)

- After the trial stage, contract work will take place within the company’s secure remote workspace, where relevant tools for the services are accessible.





COMPENSATION



This two-part compensation model is performance-oriented. It is designed for contractors who want to be rewarded for strong results, not only for time worked. The hourly service rate provides a base, but the larger earning opportunity is intended to come through performance-based discretionary bonuses after the conclusion of the evaluation period. Bonus potential is based on measurable sourcing results, including profitability, ROI, accuracy, productivity, and sell-through performance.



- This contract includes a base hourly service rate of $3 USD for approved billable service hours.

- Eligible contractors can qualify for performance-based discretionary bonuses that allow strong performers to substantially increase their total compensation through consistent, profitable sourcing results.

- A monthly Keepa Premium reimbursement is available to eligible contractors.

- A monthly internet allowance is available to eligible contractors.





WHO SHOULD APPLY



Apply if you are analytical, careful, self-directed, and serious about becoming highly effective at profitable Amazon used book sourcing.



Do not apply if you are looking for basic VA work, general admin work, or a role where the company provides all training from scratch. Contractors are expected to take responsibility for maintaining and improving the skills needed to provide high-quality sourcing services.





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please complete both steps:

Step 2) After submitting the form, return to this OnlineJobs job post and click Apply or send a message through OnlineJobs. In your OnlineJobs message:

   - Include your name as it appears on your application form.

GHL + Claude AI Social Media Automation Specialist

Part-Time | Remote | Immediate Start



WHO THIS IS FOR:



You have already built a GoHighLevel workflow that captures social media comments 
, Instagram, TikTok) and sends them to the Claude API — and you’ve done it more than once. You don’t need to “figure it out.” You need to walk in, review what’s there, and fix or improve it same day.



THE SETUP:



I run an active real estate brand in Montgomery, Alabama with 18K+ followers across
, Instagram, and TikTok. I have a GHL automation already in place that:



 • Captures incoming social media comments via custom webhooks

 • Routes them to the Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-5)

 • Returns AI-generated replies back through GHL

 • Tags contacts by platform (tiktok-comment, insta-comment, etc.)



I need someone who can keep this system running, troubleshoot issues, and make improvements as needed — including making sure every reply sounds like me, not like AI.



YOU MUST ALREADY KNOW:



? GoHighLevel — workflows, custom webhooks, sub-account management

? Claude API (Anthropic) — prompt engineering, model parameters, API calls

? Social media comment automation — not just theory, you’ve built it

? Webhook payload structure — platform-specific formatting (FB/IG vs TikTok)

? Basic JavaScript or Node.js (for any middleware/connector logic)

? System prompt engineering — ability to build and refine a voice/persona prompt so AI responses match a specific brand tone, not generic-sounding replies



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



? You’ve never connected GHL to an external AI API

? You need time to “research” how Claude works

? You can do GHL but have never touched the Anthropic API

? You’re still learning webhooks

? You think a default Claude response is “good enough” without voice customization



I will ask you to describe exactly how you’ve done this before. If you can’t, this isn’t the role.



WHAT THE WORK LOOKS LIKE:



 • On-call troubleshooting when the automation breaks or misfires

 • Maintain and refine the system prompt that defines my brand voice — responses must sound like me, not like a robot

 • Prompt refinement to keep replies sharp, on-brand, and varied across platforms

 • A/B test prompt variations as my content and audience evolves

 • Workflow adjustments as platforms change

 • Occasional new automation builds as the brand grows



PAY & HOURS:



 • Part-time to start — as-needed basis

 • Pay based on experience (negotiable, message me with your rate)

 • Strong potential to grow into ongoing retainer work



TO APPLY:



Send a message that answers these four questions:



 1. Describe a GHL + AI API automation you’ve built — what did it do and how did it work?

 2. Have you specifically worked with the Anthropic/Claude API? Which models?

 3. Have you built a system prompt to replicate a specific person’s voice or brand tone? How did you approach it and how did you test it?

 4. What’s your hourly rate or project rate?



No cover letters. Just answer the four questions. Applications that don’t answer all four will not receive a response.



Ready to copy and paste straight into OnlineJobs.ph. Want me to also draft the screening script you’d use once applications come in — so you can quickly separate the real ones from the fakers in the first reply?

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant — Philippines

Remote — Philippines | Full-Time





The Role

We're looking for an HR Assistant to support our HR Coordinator in managing HR operations, employee records, and people administration across the company. This is a remote, Philippines-based role working closely with our US-based HR team.

You will own administrative HR tasks that keep our people systems running — data entry, records management, onboarding paperwork coordination, compliance documentation, and HR reporting support. This is a detail-oriented, process-driven role that requires someone reliable, organized, and comfortable working in US business hours overlap.



What You'll Do



HR Administration

* Maintain accurate employee records in our HR system — new hires, terminations, status changes, and updates

* Coordinate onboarding paperwork for new employees — collect documents, track completion, and ensure nothing is missing

* Support offboarding administration — documentation, system updates, and record archiving

* Maintain organized digital HR files and ensure records are audit-ready at all times





Compliance & Documentation

* Track credential renewals, certifications, and licensing deadlines for clinical staff

* Maintain I-9 and employment eligibility records in accordance with US requirements

* Support compliance reporting and audit preparation as needed





Recruiting Support

* Post job openings on designated platforms as directed

* Coordinate interview scheduling between candidates and hiring managers

* Maintain applicant tracking records and communicate status updates





HR Reporting

* Pull standard HR reports from our systems — headcount, turnover, open positions

* Support the HR Coordinator with data compilation and presentation prep





Payroll Support

* Assist with weekly payroll processing by compiling and verifying timekeeping data prior to each payroll run

* Review employee clock-in and clock-out records for accuracy — flag discrepancies, missed punches, and anomalies to the HR Coordinator before payroll is finalized

* Cross-reference scheduled hours against actual hours worked and escalate any inconsistencies for review

* Maintain organized payroll records and ensure supporting documentation is complete and audit-ready

* Coordinate with managers to resolve timekeeping issues quickly and accurately

* Support the HR Coordinator with any payroll-related reporting or documentation requests





Who You Are

* 1–3 years of HR administrative experience — US-based company experience strongly preferred

* Highly organized and detail-oriented — you catch errors before they become problems

* Comfortable working with US employment documentation and terminology

* Strong written English communication skills

* Proficient in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office; HRIS experience a plus

* Available to overlap with US Central Time business hours 





Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive salary

* Full-time, remote

* Paid Philippines public holidays





To be considered for this position, when submitting your resume for consideration, be sure to answer the questions listed below: 

1) Describe your experience with payroll, HR and other people operations related work? 

2) Please confirm you can work Central Time (US) working hours.

title: Home Care Virtual Assistant/Bookkeeper (remote)
description:
Summary:   Under the general supervision of the Administrator(s), the consultant provides administrative support and customer service for a California based home care agency. The long-term position provides critical operational and accounting support.  This role ensures accurate bookkeeping records, while also balancing continuity of care by monitoring caregiver activity, responding to urgent scheduling needs, documenting i
, and supporting administrative functions. The liaison acts as the primary point of contact for caregivers and clients, which may include some after-hours, weekends, and holidays.  



Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

• Primary bookkeeping support

• Answer telephone calls in a professional and timely manner from caregivers, clients, and new inquiries

• Speak with potential clients and help schedule care consultations

• On-Call responder requiring problem solving and conflict resolution of all after-hour calls from caregivers, clients and potential clients, while exercising competent decision-making skills (i.e. call-outs, no-shows, last-minute schedule changes)

• Schedule caregivers for client shifts to ensure all shifts are staffed and ensure that caregivers’ clock-in and clock-out times are accurate for each shift

• Communicate with tea
mbers to escalate and quickly resolve issues

• Document non-emergency concerns and escalate  urgent matters per agency protocol

• Recruit caregivers (post jobs, screen applicants, schedule interviews, onboarding)

• Data entry to update software databases

• Maintain and verify accurate records

• Calls need to be answered live, or when that is not possible, messages must be returned promptly within 15 minutes

Other Duties:

• Schedules shifts and hours by matching caregiver qualifications and availability to clients’ needs and care plans, when needed

• Coordinates and communicates new assignments and/or schedule changes to caregivers and clients timely & accurately

• Keeps log of times worked, work assignments during shifts, calls taken and action taken while on-call/after hours

• Make recommendations for business process improvements; problem-solving resource

• Perform additional tasks assigned by management to support agency operations



Requirements:



• Excellent English and confident phone communication 

• Experience in bookkeeping, preferably with Quickbooks

• Experience with home care or healthcare scheduling

• Experience with WellSky, ClearCare, AxisCare, or similar software

• Ability to be professional, stay calm and solve problems under pressure

• Comfortable speaking with new clients and guiding conversations

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Proficient at handling multiple tasks in fast paced environment

• Efficient time management and ability to work independently when necessary

• Reliable equipment (internet, computer, phone line) and quiet work environment



** If you are interested in applying for this job, please add "VABK-CKLA" in the subject line for consideration.

title: Paint by Numbers Content Creator (Female) (Full time)
description:
We’re looking for someone who enjoys painting and can film the process (hands + painting only, no face needed). 



You’ll receive our Paint by Numbers kits for free, and for every completed painting + video content you send us, you’ll receive $20 USD as payment.



What You’ll Do:

 • Paint our Paint by Numbers kits (we will ship them to you at no cost).

 • Film the process: unboxing, painting progress, and final reveal.

 • Send us the raw video content (we’ll handle the editing).



What You Get:

 • $20 USD per painting (Big canvas / one set of 6 small canvases)  once you send the content.

 • A fun, relaxing activity while earning income.



Requirements:

 • No need to show your face — only hands and painting.

 • Must have a phone stand/tripod for stable filming.

 • Must have an easel to hold the canvas while painting.

 • Must have good lighting daylight so the painting is clear.

 • Able to deliver clear, good-quality video (phone camera is fine).

 • Reliable and responsive in communication.



How to Apply:

Please send:

• A sample video/example of your previous work so we can check filming and editing quality.

• A quick clip of your hands painting/drawing is also welcome.

• A shot of your painting and filming setup area.

title: Technical/Onboarding Go High Level VA
description:
# Technical Virtual Assistant (GoHighLevel & Zapier) 



BlueSky Reputation is hiring a Technical Virtual Assistant to help onboard clients, manage systems, and support our growing reputation management agency.



We help local service businesses improve their online reputation, generate more Google reviews, and improve their Google Business Profile rankings.



This is a client-facing role. You will be speaking directly with U.S. business owners on Zoom and helping them get set up successfully.



This position starts part-time with the opportunity to grow into a larger role as the company expands.



**Pay:** $8-$10 per hour depending on experience



## REQUIREMENTS



* Exceptional spoken and written English

* Near-native level English required

* Comfortable speaking with U.S. business owners on Zoom

* GoHighLevel experience

* Zapier experience

* Strong technical troubleshooting skills

* Ability to research and solve technical problems independently

* Experience integrating software and CRMs

* Strong initiative and ownership mentality

* Reliable internet and computer

* Fast communication during business hours

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision

* Professional and friendly communication style



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Conduct client onboarding calls

* Set up GoHighLevel subaccounts

* Import snapshots

* Configure pipelines and automations

* Connect CRM systems

* Troubleshoot CRM integrations

* Connect Google Business Profiles

* Connect social media accounts

* Configure review campaigns

* Complete A2P verification for subaccount phone numbers

* Import customer lists and CSV files

* Merchynt onboarding and setup

* Basic website setup in GoHighLevel

* Customer support

* Lead list preparation and formatting

* SOP creation and documentation

* Trello management

* Technical troubleshooting

* Research and resolve client setup issues



## SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



This position is paid for 10-15 hours per week to start.



The workload will vary. Some weeks may have several onboarding calls and projects, while other weeks may have very little active work.



Because this is a client-facing role, we are looking for someone who can provide reliable availability, fast communication, and flexibility to meet with clients when onboarding calls are scheduled.



You will not be expected to work a fixed daily schedule. Most work can be completed at flexible times.



However, you must:



* Respond quickly to messages during agreed-upon business hours

* Be available for scheduled client onboarding calls

* Provide timely customer support responses

* Communicate proactively regarding your availability



This role is ideal for someone who already has flexible remote work and can accommodate scheduled client meetings while maintaining excellent communication.



## INITIAL TRAINING



During the first several weeks, part of your paid hours will include:



* Learning our onboarding process

* Reviewing training materials

* Learning our systems and workflows

* Creating SOPs as processes are documented

* Building and organizing Trello boards

* Testing onboarding procedures

* Becoming familiar with our services and client setup process



All training, SOP creation, and onboarding preparation work is paid.



## COACHING & ONGOING TRAINING



The successful applicant will be added to our coaching and support group.



This includes:



* Access to ongoing training

* Ability to ask questions and get help with technical issues

* Access to group coaching calls

* Continued learning and skill development



Attendance at coaching calls is required as part of the role.



Coaching calls are held twice per week and are considered paid work time.



## IMPORTANT



Strong English is critical for this role.



Our clients are U.S. business owners, and you will be communicating with them directly. Applicants must be able to communicate naturally, confidently, and professionally in English.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership, solves problems independently, and enjoys figuring things out. Every client has a different setup, and successful applicants will be comfortable researching solutions and troubleshooting issues without needing step-by-step instructions for every task.



## TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. A 2-3 minute video introduction

3. Your GoHighLevel experience

4. Your Zapier experience

5. Examples of technical problems you have solved independently

6. Your experience integrating CRMs or software platforms

7. Your weekly availability

8. Why you believe you would be a good fit for this role



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who wants to grow with the company.

title: Appointment Setter Needed ASAP – Immediate Start
description:
CLIENT SALES REP — FULL-TIME ROLE FOR HIGH-PERFORMANCE CALLERS ONLY



This is not a chill admin job.



We’re looking for a sharp, organised, confident phone operator who can call inbound homeowner leads fast, qualify them properly, and help our renovation clients book serious $20K–$100K+ projects.



If you want an easy paycheck, this is not for you.



If you want to be part of a fast-growing agency, get paid for performance, and become genuinely valuable inside a company that promotes from within, keep reading.



ABOUT REYNMEDIA



ReynMedia is a renovation growth agency helping high-ticket renovators across Australia generate consistent qualified leads and quote opportunities.



We work with builders, bathroom renovators, kitchen companies, pool builders, landscapers, and other premium home improvement businesses.



We currently have 10 clients and are scaling aggressively toward 50, then 100+.



YOUR ROLE



Your job is simple:



Call every inbound lead, qualify them properly, and send high-quality opportunities to our clients.



You’ll be speaking with homeowners who have enquired about renovation projects and figuring out whether they are serious, qualified, and ready to move forward.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



* Call new leads immediately when they come in

* Follow up with existing leads in the pipeline

* Qualify homeowners for $20K+ renovation projects

* Use GoHighLevel CRM to track every call and update every lead

* Send qualified leads to clients through Slack

* Communicate clearly with clients about lead details

* Deliver a professional, friendly, high-quality experience on every call

* Submit daily performance reports

* Help improve scripts, processes, and outcomes over time



SCHEDULE & PAY



Hours: 9am–5pm Australian Eastern Time

Pay: $5 AUD/hour + $6 AUD commission per qualified lead

Full-time position

Uncapped commission



Our best performers can earn $600+ AUD per week.



REQUIREMENTS



* 1+ year phone-based B2C sales, appointment setting, or customer service experience

* Strong English communication skills

* Confident speaking to homeowners

* Fast, organised, and consistent

* Comfortable with direct feedback

* Experience using a CRM

* Able to work 9am–5pm Australian Eastern Time

* Reliable internet and quiet working environment



Bonus: experience with home services, trades, renovations, construction, or real estate.



YOU WILL DO WELL HERE IF...



* You care about performance

* You are coachable

* You like being held to a high standard

description:
COMPENSATION

• Expected earnings of $2,500–$5,000+ per month for top performers

• Must be available during U.S. business hours (Pacific Time preferred)



ABOUT US

We provide a specialized SaaS platform exclusively for California Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly (RCFEs), with a particular focus on 6-bed assisted living homes.



Unlike most sales positions, all leads are provided. We maintain a database of over 7,000 assisted living owner and operator contacts (decision makers) throughout California. 



All leads and contact information are provided. No lead generation, list building, prospect research, or contact sourcing is required. You will be speaking directly with facility owners, administrators, and decision-makers. No gatekeeper-heavy prospecting required.



We are seeking an experienced sales professional who can engage owners and decision-makers, build relationships, demonstrate value, and consistently close new accounts.

 marketing and follow-up campaigns

s and follow-up communications per day

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

• California Assisted Living industry experience is strongly preferred but not required

Because many of our customers are owner-operated businesses, experience with small business owners, healthcare operators, or senior living providers is highly valued. Management will provide industry-specific training.

• Experience selling to U.S.-based customers

• Self-motivated and able to work independently

• Reliable high-speed internet connection and professional home office setup



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

• A 1-2 minute audio recording introducing yourself and describing your most significant sales accomplishment.

• Details of any healthcare, senior living, or B2B sales experience

OPPORTUNITY

• This is an opportunity to enter a largely untapped niche market serving California Assisted Living 6 bed RCFE operators.

• We have already built a database of over 7,000 owner and decision-maker contacts, allowing you to focus on relationship building, product demonstrations, and closing business rather than prospecting.

• Our platform addresses real operational and occupancy challenges faced by the assisted living / 6 bed providers, creating meaningful conversations with owners who can benefit from our solution.

• This position is ideal for a sales professional who enjoys managing a pipeline, building long-term relationships, and closing new business in a growing healthcare technology company.

WHY JOIN US?

• Established California healthcare niche

• Exclusive focus on Assisted Living and 6-bed RCFE operators

• Qualified lead database of 7,000+ owner and decision-maker contacts provided

• Affordable subscription-based solution with a straightforward sales process and strong value proposition

• All leads and contact information are supplied by the company

• No prospect list building required

• Minimal direct competition in the marketplace

• Opportunity to grow with an expanding healthcare company

• Competitive base compensation plus performance-based incentives



This position is designed for a sales professional who enjoys building relationships, managing a pipeline, and closing business—not simply generating appointments.

If you are a self-motivated closer who enjoys speaking directly with business owners and decision-makers, we would love to hear from you.



Thanks

title: Operations Manager - Ecommerce
description:
Hi, I'm Wiets, the founder of TechToast Academy. We're 6 months old and sell an Arduino-compatible electronics kit for kids. It's a $199 hardware kit plus a 25-week build-along curriculum on our own learning portal, with lifetime free tech support from real engineering grads. We're doing around $200K/month, almost all fro
ta ads, and we're on track to 10x in the next 6 months.



Here's what and why I'm hiring: I'm a technical, creative founder. I'm great at setting direction and I love the creative and product  development side, but I'm not great at the people side, making sure that everyone's productive, setting deadlines, holding people to KPI's, and always knowing who is working on what. I don't like checking in on people constantly, and I don't always know how to get the best out of someone or how to motivate them properly. That gap is the single biggest thing slowing us down, and it's the job I'm hiring for.



What the team looks like at the 
nt:



1. 2 virtual assistants who run tech support and customer support over
 (one day shift, one night shift. They're genuinely great, almost no backlog ever). They also do some Arduino circuit drawings for our instruction manuals.

2. 1 product developer working on our next kit (a line-following robot). I suspect he could move faster but I don't have the energy or the know-how to manage him on it. I tried making a timeline for him but I'm honestly a bit lost on how to check in with him and make sure he is as productive and motivated as he can be. I also want to give him the right structure so that he does not get lost and always knows what to do.

3. 1 editor for our meta ads.

4.  A creative strategist coming on board. I'll stay close to this person myself, that's the part I enjoy and currently do myself. I'll still want him under your wing, to make sure he stays motivated and has good structure. This is the biggest lever in our 10x.



Our systems: At the 
nt everyone reports to me through 
. We use Shopify for the store backend. We have no project management tool and I track nothing, I just do video meetings every now and then and discuss what they're busy with now over chat during the week. I feel like this can be improved a lot. 



What I want you to take ownership of:



1. Building the machine. Setting up a proper system (project management tool, SOPs, KPIs) so that anytime I log in I can see who's doing what, what's been done, what's next for each person, and what they achieved last week or last month or whatever. I want to know I'm getting my money's worth from everyone and we're moving in the right direction.

2. Keeping everyone productive and accountable without me chasing anyone. The team comes to you for deadlines, priorities and decisions. I'll tell you what I want; you turn it into something that lands well with the team. (I'm too much of a nice guy to create or enforce a KPI, I need you to be the structure.)

3. Managing the product development timeline so we can launch products better and faster. I give the general direction ("here's the product, here's what it should do"); you figure out how to make it happen with the people we have, or tell me who we need to hire.

4. Helping me hire and scale through the 10x. Soon I'll need a curriculum writer for the new product, someone to handle photography for the circuits, an SEO person to get us organic traffic on Google (right now we're 100% Meta and I want to diversify), and probably someone to run a more junior creative-ops role under you. You'd help find and onboard these people.

5. Taking the creative-shoot logistics off my plate. We have a small content team in South Africa shooting professional family/kids footage for our ads, and setting up each shoot (venue, cast, coordination) has been a huge headache for me. I want someone to manage that end to end.



You're probably a fit if:



1. You've run operations for a team through fast growth, not just kept a small team tidy or a large team compliant.

2. You've built SOPs, KPI tracking and accountability systems from scratch.

3. You can hold people accountable in a way that motivates them rather than annoys them. This is the part I care about most.

4. Ecommerce experience is a big plus.

5. You're comfortable hiring and managing other people as we scale.



How to apply:

I kinda want to hear what you can do for me before hearing what you have done for others. Instead of telling me about your past jobs, tell me about MY business. Based on everything I explained above (and feel free to look at techtoast.academy):



1. What's the first system you'd build in your first 30 days, and what would it actually look like? Be specific.

2. I think my product developer could be faster but I don't know how to manage or measure that. How would you handle it?

3. We're all on 
 with zero tracking. What would you set up so I can log in and instantly see who's doing what, what's done, and what each person achieved last week?



One more thing: just write it out in normal text, no need for obviously-AI generated highly formatted responses.

title: Virtual Assistant: Lead Generation, Content and Social Media
description:
About ComplyEdge



ComplyEdge® is a Sydney-based regulatory compliance and risk advisory firm. We help Australian businesses meet their regulatory obligations and turn compliance into a commercial advantage.



Not Just Compliance. It’s an Edge.



We work across six service lines: Regulatory Compliance Advisory, AML/CTF and Financial Crime Compliance, Employment and IR Compliance, Regulatory Response and Breach Management, a Managed Compliance Partner retainer, and Regulatory Health Reviews. Our clients range from professional services practices to financial services businesses across Australia.



We are a growing firm that works to a high standard. The person we hire will work directly with our Director and Principal Consultant and will play a genuine part in how the business grows.

About the Role



We are looking for a capable, reliable virtual assistant to support three areas of the business: lead generation and pipeline building, content creation and social media management, and day-to-day administration.



This is a long-term role for someone organised, proactive, and comfortable working independently. You will report to the Director and work remotely from the Philippines, with a few hours of daily overlap with Sydney business hours for live coordination.



You do not need a compliance background. You do need strong written English, sound judgement, attention to detail, and the discipline to manage your own workload and meet deadlines.



What You’ll Do



Lead Generation and Pipeline Support



• Research and build targeted lists of prospective business clients from public sources such as LinkedIn, industry directories, and the web.

• Identify decision-makers at firms that fit our ideal client profile and capture accurate contact details.

• Draft and send first-touch outreach and follow-up messages using approved templates and our brand voice.

• Maintain a clean, up-to-date pipeline in our CRM, logging activity, responses, and next steps.

• Track outreach performance and prepare simple weekly summaries of leads generated and meetings booked.

• Schedule discovery calls and keep the Director’s pipeline organised.



Content Creation and Social Media Management

• Manage and grow our social media presence, primarily LinkedIn and Instagram including scheduling and publishing approved posts.

• Set up and optimise social profiles, including headlines, banners, and company page details.

• Draft posts, captions, and short-form content aligned to our brand voice and style guide, for review and approval before publishing.

• Repurpose longer pieces into carousels, graphics, and snippets using tools such as Canva.

• Build and maintain a content calendar and keep a consistent posting schedule.

• Monitor engagement, respond to comments and messages as directed, and report on reach and engagement.

• Carry out light editing of documents, graphics, and short videos to a clean, professional standard.

Administrative Support

• Manage the calendar, schedule appointments, and coordinate meetings across time zones.

• Triage and manage the inbox and respond to routine enquiries as directed.

• Prepare and format documents, presentations, reports, and meeting notes.

• Keep digital files and folders organised and easy to find.

• Carry out internet and general research and compile findings into clear summaries.

• Provide general operational support to keep the business running smoothly.



What We’re Looking For



Essential



• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Two or more years of experience in a virtual assistant, lead generation, marketing, or administrative role.

• Hands-on experience with lead generation and prospecting, ideally including LinkedIn.

• Experience managing social media, especially LinkedIn and Instagram, including scheduling tools.

• Confident with Canva or similar tools for simple graphics and content.

• Comfortable with CRMs, spreadsheets, and common productivity and scheduling tools.

• Strong organisation, attention to detail, and the ability to manage your own time and meet deadlines.

• A reliable, private internet connection and your own computer.

• Professional, discreet, and trustworthy, with genuine respect for confidentiality.



Nice to Have



• Experience supporting Australian, UK, or US businesses.

• Background in professional services, finance, or B2B services.

• Basic video editing and graphic design skills.

• Familiarity with SEO basics and
 marketing tools.

• Experience writing first-draft business or marketing copy.



Why You’ll Like Working With Us



• A long-term, stable role with an established Australian firm.

• Direct access to the founder and real ownership of your work.

• Clear expectations, organised systems, and respectful communication.

• Room to grow your responsibilities as the business grows.



How We Work



• Engagement.  Independent contractor. You are responsible for your own taxes and statutory obligations in the Philippines.

• Hours.  Part Time. Set hours by agreement, with daily overlap with Sydney business hours for coordination.

• Location.  Fully remote from the Philippines.

• Pay.  Paid in accordance with agreed timing (weekly or fortnightly)

• Tools and security.  You will use your own device with up-to-date security software and a private, secure internet connection. Access to our systems is through assigned, personal logins with multi-factor authentication.

• Confidentiality.  ComplyEdge works in a regulated industry. The successful candidate will sign a non-disclosure agreement and follow our confidentiality and data-handling standards. This role focuses on business development, content, and administration. It is not a client compliance role.



How to Apply



We read every application properly, so please follow these steps:

1. Start your message with the word EDGE so we know you have read this advert in full.

2. Tell us briefly why this role suits you and share your most relevant experience.

3. Include links or examples of social media profiles you have managed, or lead generation results you are proud of.

4. Note your available hours and your expected monthly rate.

title: WooCommerce Website Assistance
description:
# WooCommerce Website Assistant — Maison Élan Collections



Maison Élan Collections is a curated home décor website with products, categories, images, descriptions, and SEO information already in place. I am looking for a detail-oriented VA to help review, organize, and polish the existing site so the customer experience is clear, professional, and easy to follow.



This is not a redesign or rebuild role. Your job is to use what is already built and help make it seamless for the customer.



This will begin as a paid 2-week trial project. During the trial, the focus will be reviewing assigned product pages, checking the customer experience, identifying issues, and providing clear updates. If the work is accurate, organized, and communication is strong, this can become an ongoing weekly position.



Your work will include reviewing product pages for accuracy and consistency, including • titles • descriptions • images • prices • categories • tags • variations. You will also review the site from the customer’s point of view, including • desktop pages • mobile pages • links • buttons • menus • navigation • anything broken, confusing, unfinished, or unprofessional.



From day one, you should be able to log in, review assigned pages, spot customer-facing issues, follow instructions, and provide a clear update on what was reviewed, fixed, or still needs attention.



Required experience includes • WordPress • WooCommerce • product page review • basic SEO fields • website quality control • mobile and desktop testing • clear written communication. Experience with Yoast SEO and e-commerce catalog management is a plus.



Weekly updates must clearly explain • what you reviewed • what you fixed • what problems you found • what still needs attention • screenshots when useful. Please do not send vague updates such as "everything looks good." I need specific details.



Please include the phrase Maison Review Ready somewhere in your application.



Also answer the following:



• When reviewing a product page, what are the first three things you look at and why?



• If you found a product with excellent images but a confusing description, what would your next step be?



• A customer tells you they cannot find a product they viewed yesterday. What are three possible causes you would investigate?



• When reviewing a website on mobile, what are the most common issues you look for?



• If you were asked to review 50 products, how would you organize your work to ensure nothing was missed?



• What information would you want before making changes to a live product page?



• Choose any e-commerce website you are familiar with and identify one thing that improves the customer experience and one thing that could be improved.



• In one or two sentences, tell me what you believe is the biggest reason customers leave an online store without making a purchase.



• What is your desired hourly rate for this position?



• Are you willing to begin with a paid 2-week trial period before transitioning to an ongoing role if we are a good fit for each other?



Please include links to websites or stores you have worked on, if available.



The goal is simple: use what is already built, identify anything that may confuse customers, and help make Maison Élan clean, organized, and easy to shop from homepage to checkout.

title: Instagram Story Designer (Story Sequences)
description:
I run a marketing agency and I need someone reliable to build Instagram story sequences for me and my clients. These are multi slide story posts with bold text overlays, highlights, arrows, and embedded photos laid over a background image. If you have a good eye for clean layouts and can follow a template closely, this is for you.



There are two parts to the job:



Part 1: One off batch (start here)

I will give you one finished story sequence as the master template. Your job is to rebuild that exact same sequence for 15 different people. Same copy, same layout, same style on every slide. The only thing that changes is the background photo for each person. So 15 versions of the same sequence, just swapped backgrounds.



Part 2: Ongoing (the main role)

Once you nail the batch, you move into an ongoing role building fresh story sequences for me personally, every day or every other day. I will give you the copy and direction, you build the slides in the same style and send them back ready to post.



What you will do



 • Rebuild story sequences slide by slide from a template

 • Swap background images cleanly without breaking the layout

 • Keep text, spacing, highlights, and arrows consistent across every slide

 • Export in correct story dimensions ready to upload

 • Turn work around quickly and follow feedback the first time



What I am looking for



 • Strong design eye, clean and consistent work

 • Comfortable with Canva, Photoshop, or similar (tell me what you use)

 • Fast, organised, and good at following a template exactly

 • Reliable daily availability and quick replies

 • Bonus if you have made Instagram story or reel content before



Hours

Part time. The one off batch of 15 sequences is the paid trial. If it goes well this becomes an ongoing role building one sequence a day or every other day.



Pay

$150 to $200/month depending on experience, for ongoing daily or every other day work. The first 15 sequence batch is the trial and is paid.



To apply



 1. Send 2 or 3 examples of story or social content you have made

 2. Tell me what tools you use

 3. Start your message with the word BANANA so I know you read this properly

 4. Confirm you’re happy with the pay range and tell me your availability



Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the role



We're an AI-native B2B revenue platform. The product is built and growing — a client dashboard, payment and onboarding pipelines, partner portals, and the automation layer underneath. The architecture and product direction are owned. What we need is someone who takes architectural decisions and follows through on them across the full stack — frontend and backend — shipping clean, fast, and without hand-holding.



You won't be setting the overall product direction, but you will be trusted to execute architectural decisions that touch both the frontend and backend of the product, and to carry them through end to end. If you're great at turning a clear direction into shipped, working software across the whole stack, read on.



What you'll do



Execute architectural decisions across frontend and backend, owning the implementation from spec to shipped

Build features against a defined architecture: dashboard UI, internal tools, API endpoints, data syncs

Write and wire backend logic — webhooks, scheduled jobs, third-party API integrations

Work directly against Supabase (Postgres/PostgREST), keep the schema and constraints clean

Build and maintain n8n workflows connecting payment, CRM, and outreach systems

Ship, test, and flag issues before they hit production

Keep ticket status updated in real time — status is the source of truth, not what's in your head

Stack you'll work in



Supabase (Postgres, PostgREST, RLS), n8n, Make, React, Node, Render, Stripe, Clay, Smartlead, Airtable, Apollo, and REST APIs across HeyReach/Wise and similar. You don't need every one, but you need to pick up an unfamiliar API from docs fast and without supervision.



You're a fit if you



Can follow through on architectural decisions that affect both the frontend and backend of a product

Are fluent with AI-assisted development — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar agentic IDEs are part of how you ship

Ship working code from a written spec without needing it re-explained

Are comfortable in Postgres: schema design to a brief, constraints, joins, upserts/on-conflict

Have built real integrations against third-party APIs (webhooks, auth, idempotency, retries)

Read docs and figure things out rather than waiting to be told

Batch your questions, flag blockers early, and keep status current

Have reasonable overlap with UK hours for a daily sync

Preferred experience



Background in the lead gen / GTM / outbound space (Clay, n8n automations, Smartlead, Make, cold
/LinkedIn infrastructure)

Built automation systems or campaign tooling at an agency or GTM startup

Stripe (Checkout, webhooks, Payment Links)

Worked somewhere you owned delivery, not just tickets

How you'll be evaluated



The interview is a paid test task: one real ticket from our backlog, tightly scoped. We're looking at whether you ship it clean, whether you caught the edge cases, whether you kept us updated, and whether you needed babysitting. That's the whole signal.

This role requires understanding how agents actually function in systems, not just how to write prompts.

Designing prompts for multi-step agents (intake ? qualification ? routing ? summary)

Translating business workflows into agent logic and constraints

Defining clear inputs, outputs, and stop conditions

Designing escalation rules and safe failure paths

Testing agents against edge cases and ambiguous inputs

Maintaining and improving agents post-deployment

Documenting agent behaviour and prompt logic in Notion

Must-Have Knowledge (Non-Negotiable)

You must understand and be able to demonstrate:

What an AI agent is (vs a chatbot or single prompt)

Agent loops, triggers, and task boundaries

The difference between:

reasoning vs execution

autonomy vs supervision

How agents interact with:


forms

CRMs

automation tools (Make/Zapier)

Designing agents that:

never guess

never invent data

escalate when unsure

stop once their task is complete

Prompt patterns for:

information collection

rule enforcement

classification and routing

summarisation (not generation)

If you’ve only written creative prompts or chatbots, this role is not a fit.

Required Skills

Strong written English (precise, calm, professional)

Logical, systems-based thinking

Experience building or assisting with agent-based workflows

Comfort working with constraints and rules

High attention to reliability and failure modes

Nice to Have

OpenAI model experience

Make or Zapier experience

Business operations or admin background

UK B2B service environment exposure

What This Role Is Not

Not creative AI writing

Not chatbot development

Not research or experimentation

Why AgentOps

Real production systems

Clear standards

Calm, professional culture

Long-term work, not gig tasks

If you enjoy making AI dependable, this role will suit you.

title: Marketing Operations & Website Support VA
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



I’m looking for a part-time Marketing Operations & Website Support VA to support the implementation side of my business marketing systems and website.



This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working inside Squarespace, ClickUp,
 platforms, and forms, and who can take approved content or existing materials and turn them into polished, functional, well-organized assets and workflows.



This is not a senior brand or marketing strategy role. I’m looking for someone strong in implementation, systems, layout, organization, and follow-through.



About the Business



I run a fundraising consulting business that supports nonprofit organizations with strategy, campaigns, and systems. As the business grows, I’m looking for support with the operational side of marketing and website management so things stay clear, consistent, polished, and functional behind the scenes.



I already have website copy, marketing content, and a general direction for much of this work. I do not currently have a formal brand book or fully documented brand standards, so I’m looking for someone who is comfortable working from my existing website, content, and materials and helping bring greater consistency, polish, and clarity through implementation.



What You’ll Be Doing



 - Make updates to my Squarespace website, including copy updates, formatting, layout cleanup, and blog post formatting

 - Take existing website copy and approved content and turn it into visually polished, well-structured website pages with stronger hierarchy, readability, and flow

 - Improve page structure, visual hierarchy, spacing, and presentation within Squarespace

 - Set up, check, and test
 automations and related workflows

 - Help move or recreate forms from Typeform into ClickUp forms and make sure connected workflows and automations are functioning properly

 - Test forms, automations, and backend workflows to make sure things are functioning properly

 - Review website and marketing workflows and flag anything that appears broken, inconsistent, incomplete, or unclear

 - Organize marketing assets, content, and workflow documentation

 - Draft short-form social copy from approved source materials, including podcast episode summaries, newsletter content, website copy, or campaign messaging, for review and approval

 - Support related implementation tasks such as formatting
s, updating landing pages, or organizing backend marketing systems

 - Assist periodically with basic client automation, form, or workflow implementation tasks, where needed and clearly assigned



What Matters Most



Strong attention to detail, comfort with systems, and good judgment are the most important requirements for this role.



I’m looking for someone who can work from existing content, approved copy, and current systems and turn that into clean, polished work with minimal hand-holding. This role requires someone who notices small issues, thinks through how things function, and communicates clearly when something needs clarification.



Experience with Squarespace is important. Experience with forms, automations, and
 platforms is also important. You do not need a full marketing plan or formal brand standards to work from. You do need to be comfortable looking at what already exists, identifying patterns, and making sound implementation decisions that improve consistency and presentation.



You should also have a strong enough eye for web layout and presentation to make good decisions about spacing, hierarchy, readability, and overall page polish.



This Role Is a Good Fit If You:



 - Are confident working in Squarespace

 - Can make content look cleaner, clearer, and more polished online

 - Are comfortable with forms, automations,
 workflows, and backend systems

 - Can carefully test workflows and catch problems before they become bigger issues

 - Can take approved source material and turn it into finished, polished assets

 - Are highly organized and able to keep details moving across multiple tools and tasks

 - Can work independently once you understand the task and the system

 - Communicate clearly and ask useful questions when needed

 - Are interested in a longer-term working relationship



Qualities Needed to Succeed



Integrity

You communicate honestly, follow through on commitments, and let me know if something is unclear or delayed.



Commitment

I’m looking for someone interested in building a longer-term working relationship, not just completing one quick task.



Attention to Detail

You notice broken links, odd spacing, inconsistent formatting, missing steps, incomplete setups, and small issues that others often miss.



Good Judgment

You can make sensible decisions about formatting, organization, layout, and workflow without needing constant direction.



Systems Thinking

You are comfortable thinking through how things connect, how a workflow should function, and where something may be breaking down.



To Apply



Use cccops03 in your subject line. Please begin the first line of your
 application with the words website workflow support.



Please also include:



 - A short note about your experience with Squarespace, website updates, forms, automations, or marketing operations support

 - A brief description of the platforms and tools you’ve used

 - One or two examples of similar work you’ve done

 - A short description of how you would test an
 automation or form workflow before launch

 - A note about your current availability and any other clients or jobs you currently have



This is a part-time role to start, with an estimated workload of approximately 5-10 hours per week, with the opportunity for growth. Hours may vary somewhat depending on active priorities and projects.

title: CFO
description:
Job Title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) - ICON Amsterdam



Type: Full-Time



About ICON Amsterdam:

ICON Amsterdam is a leading men's fashion brand renowned for its fusion of contemporary design and timeless sophistication. As we continue to expand our global presence, we are seeking an experienced and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to play a key role in our financial management and growth strategies.



Responsibilities:



Financial Strategy:



Develop and implement financial strategies aligned with the company's overall objectives.

Provide leadership in financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting.



Financial Reporting:



Prepare accurate and timely financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.

Present financial performance to executive leadership and stakeholders.



Risk Management:



Identify and assess financial risks, implementing strategies to mitigate potential challenges.

Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.



Budget Management:



Collaborate with department heads to develop budgets and monitor financial performance against targets.

Implement cost-control measures while maintaining a high standard of quality.



Cash Flow Management:



Optimize cash flow by managing working capital and overseeing treasury functions.

Develop and implement strategies to maximize liquidity and minimize financial risks.

Financial Decision Support:



Provide financial insights and guidance to support strategic decision-making.

Conduct financial analysis and modeling for business initiatives.



Audit and Compliance:



Manage the audit process, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.

Implement and maintain effective internal controls.

Investment Strategies:



Collaborate with executive leadership to evaluate investment opportunities and provide financial analysis for decision-making.

Optimize the financial structure to support business growth.



Qualifications:



- Proven experience as a CFO or in a senior financial leadership role within the fashion or e-commerce industry.

- Strong financial acumen with a track record of successful financial management.

- Excellent calculation skills

- Excellent leadership and communication skills.

- Minimum of 2 years experience with Shopify

- Master in Excel



In-depth knowledge of financial regulations, accounting principles, and reporting standards.

Strategic thinker with the ability to contribute to overall business strategy.

Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field (MBA or CPA preferred).



How to Apply:

If you are a seasoned financial executive with a passion for fashion and a commitment to driving financial excellence, we invite you to apply for this job with your CV and Motivation. Also, mention in front of your message the text "I NEED THIS JOB"



ICON Amsterdam is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages individuals of all backgrounds to apply. Join us as we redefine the financial landscape of the men's fashion industry and contribute to the success of ICON Amsterdam.

The site supports a paid

This starts at around 5 hours per month but has strong potential to grow as we expand our digital product suite and content library. We're looking for someone to grow with us, not just fill a slot.

 directly.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Highly Engaging "Yap" Style to Start) - Long Term
description:
We are looking for a talented, detail-oriented Short-Form Video Editor to join our content creation team. You will be responsible for taking raw video footage and turning it into highly engaging vertical videos (45 seconds to 1:30 long) for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



Our Content Roadmap:

We are going to start exclusively with a clean, high-retention "yap video" style. The editing for this phase needs to be simple but highly engaging, relying on frequent framing adjustments rather than flashy graphics. However, as our channel grows, this role *will eventually evolve* to include high-quality B-roll style videos with voiceovers and captions, as well as simple, comedic-style content. We want someone who can grow into those styles with us.



This is a video by video basis, but looking for a long term partnership that could turn into a part-time thing! 





Content Workflow & Delivery (Crucial Requirement)



Our production system relies on hook testing. For every video concept I film moving forward:

 I will record 1 Body and 3 Different Hooks all in one raw file.

 You will need to edit 3 final video versions per concept (the body stays the same, only the opening hook changes).

 

Delivery Requirement: For each version, you must deliver two exports:

   1. One version **WITH** burned-in captions/on-screen text.

   2. One version **WITHOUT** captions/text (just the clean, cropped video with audio).



 Total delivery per standard concept = 6 final video files.





Key Responsibilities



Dynamic Framing:Frequently crop in and out every few seconds to match the pacing of the speech, emphasize key phrases, and keep the visual layout dynamic.

 

Cut Dead Space: Edit down talking-head footage to ensure a fast-paced, high-retention flow (remove stutters, pauses, and breaths).

 

Hook Variations: Cleanly splice the different hooks onto the front of the same video body to create distinct assets.

 

Clean File Management: Export and organize both captioned and non-captioned versions clearly in Google Drive.



Requirements

 * Strong proficiency in English (both written and spoken) to seamlessly match hooks to the body.

 * High attention to detail and ability to handle multiple file exports efficiently.

 * A reliable, high-speed internet connection.

 * Experience editing vertical short-form content with a proven portfolio (experience with B-roll editing and comedic timing is a huge plus for the future!).



?? IMPORTANT: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS (READ CAREFULLY) ??



To filter out automated applications and find the absolute best fit, **you must complete a quick "Recreate Assignment" to be considered.**

 1. Watch the Inspiration Videos: Look at how these finished videos are styled, paced, and specifically how they crop in and out to keep the energy high:

   * Video Inspo 1:

 2. Download the Raw Test Asset: Go to this Google Drive folder to download the raw footage for our test assignment: 

 3. Your Task: Take our raw asset and edit it to match the exact style, pacing, and crop-in/crop-out technique seen in the inspiration links above. (Note: For this specific test video, there is only 1 hook provided, so you only need to submit two total files: one version WITH captions, and one version WITHOUT captions).



How to Apply:

Reply to this post with:

 1. A brief introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

title: Brand Marketing Coordinator
description:
# Brand Marketing Coordinator

**Karst — North Charleston, SC**



Karst is a strategic merch and creative agency. We help lifestyle and growth-stage brands extend who they are into the physical world — intentionally, at scale, never the disposable junk that ends up in a drawer. We've been doing it since 1996.



Here's the honest version of why this role exists:



Our founder has the marketing strategy. The ideas, the calendar, the direction — all there. What's missing is the person who takes it and *makes it real*. Designs it, builds it, posts it, ships it.



That's you.



This isn't a brief-and-wait role. You'll own marketing execution end to end, so the strategy actually leaves the building instead of dying in a doc.



## What you'll own

- **Internal marketing.** You turn strategy and rough ideas into finished, on-brand work.

- **Social content.** We hand you a bucket of ideas and raw material — you finesse it, design it, schedule it, and actually hit publish.

- **HubSpot.**
, landing pages, workflows, keeping the CRM working for us instead of the other way around.

- **WordPress.** Updates, campaign hubs, landing pages, keeping the site sharp.

- **Quality control** on any overflow design we send to contractors — so the founder doesn't have to babysit it.



## Who you are

- You've spent **at least 3 years doing marketing execution** — not studying it, not "assisting with" it. Designing, building, posting, owning it.

- You can design *and* organize. Rare combo. That's the whole point of this seat.

- **HubSpot:** you've built
s, workflows, and landing pages in it — not just hit "send" on a campaign someone else set up.

- **WordPress:** you've built and edited pages, not only written blog posts.

- You're sharp in Canva and ideally Adobe, and you have a portfolio that proves it.

- You'd rather own a thing than wait for instructions. You won't get daily art direction here.

- You have taste, you sweat the details, and you'll tell us when something's off-brand or not good enough yet.



Honestly? I care less about the exact year count than what you can show me. But green won't cut it for this seat — you'll be running things, not learning them on our dime.



## This isn't your seat if

- You need a detailed brief and a sign-off before every task.

- "Marketing" to you means scheduling posts someone else designed.

- You're juggling five other clients and this would be gig number six.

- You don't have work to show.



## What the first 90 days look like

- The backlog of strategized-but-never-posted content is live.

- Social is consistent — and it looks like us.

- The founder is out of the execution weeds and back in the strategy seat where she belongs.



## Logistics

- **Type:** Full-time, remote

- **Hours:** Some daily overlap with US Eastern time (we'll work out specifics)



## To apply

Read this whole post first. Then:

- Send your **portfolio link.** No link, no read. We want social,
, and web work you actually made.

- Pick one piece you took from idea to live, and tell us in a few sentences what you'd change about it now. We're reading how you think, not just what you made.

- Start your message with the word **"Unsupervised"** so we know you made it to the bottom.



Applications that skip these get deleted. Nothing personal — it's just the first test.
