title: Hospice Coding Specialist (Remote – Philippines)
description:
About EZ Scribe LLC



EZ Scribe LLC provides clinical documentation, coding, and compliance support exclusively to U.S.-based hospice organizations. Our mission is to help hospice providers maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation while meeting Medicare, CMS, and regulatory requirements.



We are expanding our hospice coding division and are seeking an experienced Hospice Coding Specialist who can independently review, code, and support hospice documentation across multiple client organizations and electronic medical record (EMR) systems.



This position is designed for highly skilled professionals who require minimal supervision and can confidently manage coding responsibilities while maintaining compliance with Medicare hospice regulations.



Position Overview:



We are hiring a seasoned Hospice Coding Specialist to work remotely from the Philippines. The primary responsibility is reviewing hospice documentation and assigning accurate ICD-10 codes that support hospice eligibility, reimbursement, and regulatory compliance.



The ideal candidate has extensive experience working with U.S. Medicare-certified hospice providers, understands hospice clinical documentation requirements, and can adapt quickly to multiple EMR platforms and organizational workflows.



Only applicants with proven hospice coding experience supporting U.S. hospice providers will be considered.



Key Responsibilities:



Hospice ICD-10 Coding

-Review hospice admission, recertification, transfer, revocation, discharge, and death records.

-Assign accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes supporting terminal prognosis and related conditions.

-Ensure coding accurately reflects the patient's terminal illness, comorbidities, and symptom burden.

-Maintain compliance with Medicare hospice regulations, CMS guidelines, and coding standards.



Hospice Eligibility & Documentation Review:



-Review physician certifications, face-to-face encounter documentation, hospice election statements, and supporting clinical records.

-Verify documentation supports hospice eligibility and terminal prognosis requirements.

-Identify missing, conflicting, or insufficient documentation that could increase audit or denial risk.

-Provide clear and concise feedback to clinicians and hospice staff regarding documentation deficiencies.



Compliance & Regulatory Support:



-Stay current on Medicare hospice regulations, CMS guidance, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and hospice Conditions of Participation.

-Assist hospice providers in maintaining documentation that is audit-ready and compliant.

-Support preparation for ADRs, TPE reviews, UPIC audits, and other regulatory reviews when needed.



Quality Assurance Support:



-Perform chart audits and documentation reviews as needed.

-Review nursing, social work, chaplain, hospice aide, volunteer, and interdisciplinary documentation for completeness and compliance.

-Ensure plans of care, interdisciplinary group (IDG) documentation, visit notes, and recertification records support the patient's hospice status and ongoing eligibility.

-Identify trends and opportunities for documentation improvement.



Multi-Organization Support:



-Work independently across multiple hospice organizations simultaneously.

-Adapt to different documentation standards, workflows, and operational requirements.

-Maintain productivity while managing varying client expectations and deadlines.

-Demonstrate the ability to work autonomously with minimal oversight.



EMR & System Proficiency:



-Navigate and work efficiently within multiple hospice EMR systems.

-Learn new charting platforms quickly with minimal training.

-Maintain organization and accuracy while switching between client environments.



Collaboration:



-Communicate effectively with hospice clinicians, administrators, quality assurance personnel, compliance teams, and physicians.

-Participate in case discussions and coding reviews as needed.

-Provide education and coding guidance when documentation clarification is required.



Qualifications:



-Required Experience

-Minimum 3 years of direct hospice coding experience supporting U.S. Medicare-certified hospice providers.

-Demonstrated experience independently coding hospice charts and reviewing documentation for compliance.

-Experience supporting multiple hospice organizations and managing competing priorities.

-Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Certifications:



One or more of the following certifications is required or strongly preferred:

-HCS-H

-HCS-D

-CPC

-CCS

-BCHH-C

Other recognized hospice or coding certifications



Hospice Expertise:



-Advanced understanding of Medicare hospice regulations and Conditions of Participation.

-Strong knowledge of hospice eligibility requirements, terminal diagnosis selection, and supporting documentation requirements.

-Ability to identify documentation deficiencies that may affect reimbursement, compliance, or audit outcomes.

-Familiarity with LCD guidelines, hospice audit risk areas, and documentation standards.

-Strong understanding of physician certifications, face-to-face requirements, recertifications, and hospice election documentation.



Clinical Background:



-Registered Nurse (RN)

-Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)

-Hospice clinician with coding experience

-Graduate of an accredited medical coding program with significant hospice experience



Technical Skills:



-Experience working within multiple hospice EMR systems.

-Familiarity with platforms such as MatrixCare, Netsmart, WellSky Hospice, Axxess Hospice, Suncoast, HospiceWorks, or similar hospice-specific systems.

-Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and secure cloud-based file sharing.



Communication:



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to write clear coding rationale, documentation feedback, audit findings, and compliance notes.



Work Environment:



-Fully remote position.

-Reliable high-speed internet connection required.

-Secure and HIPAA-compliant workspace required.

-Ability to work during U.S. business hours.



Compliance Requirements:



-Must sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA).

-Must comply with HIPAA privacy and security requirements.

-Must maintain strict confidentiality of all protected health information.



Compensation & Benefits:



-Competitive hourly compensation based on experience, certifications, and hospice expertise.

-Long-term remote opportunity.

-Flexible scheduling options.

-Exposure to multiple hospice organizations and clinical environments.

-Opportunity for advancement into senior coding, auditing, and compliance roles.



How to Apply,  Please submit:



-Resume/CV

-Proof of coding certification(s)

-Cover letter detailing your hospice coding experience



In your application, please include:



-The U.S. hospice organizations or hospice projects you have supported.

-Your years of hospice coding experience.

-Hospice EMR systems you have worked within.

-Examples of how you have independently managed coding responsibilities across multiple hospice organizations.

-Experience supporting hospice compliance, audits, documentation improvement, or quality assurance initiatives.



Applications from candidates without direct U.S. hospice coding experience will not be considered.

title: Youtube Video Editor HIGH QUALITY
description:
# YouTube Video Editor (Educational / Talking Head Content)



## Position Type



Part-Time / Ongoing Contractor



---



## About This Role



We have an existing editor and are building a reliable, long-term team. This is not a desperate replacement gig — we're looking for someone who can grow with the channel, deliver consistently, and become a trusted part of our production workflow.



---



## Compensation



Per-package pricing (no video = no pay):



**Starting Rate (Trial + First Month):**

- $50 per video package

- Includes:

- 1 long-form YouTube video (5–10 min final runtime)

- 5–7 short-form vertical clips

- 1 custom thumbnail



**Scaling Rate (After Proven Consistency):**

- $75–$100 per package after 4–6 successful deliveries

- Based on quality, reliability, and communication



**Additional standalone shorts:**

- $5 each

- $6–$8 if heavier editing or custom graphics required



**Payment Schedule:**

- Every 2 weeks

- Only for packages actually delivered and approved



---



## About The Channel



This channel focuses on:



- mortgages

- real estate

- financial education

- wealth-building concepts



The editing style should feel:



- modern

- clean

- high-retention

- professional

- trustworthy



The goal is NOT gimmicky or overhyped editing.



We want viewers to feel:

*"Clear, calm, confident guidance."*



Style references:



- Graham Stephan

- Ali Abdaal

- Mark Tilbury



---



## What You'll Be Editing



You will primarily edit:



- talking-head educational videos

- financial storytelling content

- mortgage strategy content

- real-world buyer scenarios



Typical long-form videos:



- 5–10 minutes



You will also create:



- YouTube Shorts

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok clips

- LinkedIn vertical clips



---



## Responsibilities



### Long-Form Editing



You will:



- remove mistakes, pauses, filler words

- tighten pacing for retention

- add subtle zoom cuts and jump cuts

- add clean captions and text emphasis

- add occasional b-roll and overlays

- integrate provided infographics and visuals

- use light background music and subtle sound design

- maintain a clean, modern YouTube pacing style



### Short-Form Content



From each long-form video:



- identify strong hook 
nts

- create 5–7 vertical clips

- format properly for 9:16 platforms

- add captions and pacing optimized for retention

- create clips that drive viewers toward the long-form video



**IMPORTANT:**

Shorts should feel like previews and curiosity-builders — not full summaries.



### Thumbnails



You will create 1 custom thumbnail per long-form video:



- clean, modern design

- clear focal point

- readable text at small sizes

- consistent with channel branding



### Visual / Graphics Work



You may occasionally:



- add simple motion graphics

- integrate charts and infographics

- use stock footage selectively

- organize visuals to improve understanding



Most visuals and scripts will be provided.



---



## Editing Style Requirements



We are looking for editors who understand:



- pacing

- storytelling rhythm

- educational retention

- visual clarity

- modern YouTube editing



This is NOT 
 editing.



We prefer:



- clean cinematic pacing

- calm confidence

- modern documentary feel

- clarity over flashy effects



---



## NON-NEGOTIABLES



### Accuracy Matters



This is financial and mortgage content.



All:



- text

- numbers

- names

- graphics

- statistics



MUST match the spoken audio exactly.



Editors who consistently miss details will not be a fit.



### Communication



We value:



- responsiveness

- reliability

- professionalism

- clear communication

- consistency



If deadlines change, communicate early. Silence is the fastest way to lose this role.



### Turnaround Expectations



Typical turnaround:



- 24–48 hours for long-form edit

- Revisions handled quickly



---



## Workflow



Typical workflow:



1. Long-form video delivered first

2. Revisions completed

3. Shorts created from approved final video

4. Thumbnail finalized



We are building:



- templates

- SOPs

- editing systems

- reusable assets



Goal: Create a smooth long-term production workflow.



---



## Included Resources



You will usually receive:



- raw footage

- script

- topic context

- visual references

- infographic assets

- branding direction



---



## Required Skills



- YouTube editing

- Short-form editing

- CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro

- Understanding of pacing and retention

- Good English comprehension

- Ability to follow detailed instructions

- Basic thumbnail design



Bonus:



- motion graphics

- advanced thumbnail design

- educational content editing

- storytelling instincts



---



## Important Notes



We are looking for:



- long-term relationship

- reliability

- someone who grows with the channel



This role may scale to:



- multiple videos per week

- additional responsibilities

- increased compensation over time based on consistency and quality



---



## Application Requirements



Please include:



1. 2–3 YouTube videos you edited

2. 2–3 short-form videos you edited

3. 1–2 thumbnail examples

4. Your editing software

5. Your turnaround time for a 5–10 minute video

6. Your rate per package (1 long-form + 5–7 shorts + 1 thumbnail)

7. Your internet speed

8. Your 
 or WhatsApp



**IMPORTANT:**

Start your application message with the word:



**"EVEREST"**



I'll reply with a youtube video to see if your current skills can match this level of quality.



---



## Auto-Disqualifiers



We will not consider applicants who:



- Don't include the word "EVEREST" at the start of their message

- Don't include portfolio examples

- Quote rates wildly outside our range without explanation

- Take more than 48 hours to respond during the application process



---



## Trial Process



Selected editors will complete a paid trial edit.



The trial allows both sides to:



- test workflow

- test communication

- test editing style fit

- determine long-term compatibility



We value long-term consistency over short-term speed.

title: Go High Level Website Designer
description:
GOHLEVEL WEBSITE DESIGNER NEEDED - IT COMPANY - SPOKANE, WA



We are building a professional multi-page website inside GoHighLevel for a managed IT and technology advisory company. This is a website, not a funnel. If your portfolio is funnel pages and automation screenshots this job is not for you.





THE PROJECT



44 pages total broken into two phases.



PHASE ONE is 8 pages and the priority: home, about, contact, book a free assessment, 404, privacy policy, terms and conditions, and cookie policy. Get these live fast.



PHASE TWO is the remaining 36 pages: a services overview, 15 individual service pages, an advisory services overview, 5 advisory service pages, an industries overview, 8 industry pages, a client agreements page, 4 agreement pages, and a sitemap. These complete the project and are due by end of July.



PHASE THREE of 160 additional pages may follow as a separate project if the site converts. That is not part of this contract.





WHAT IS READY FOR YOU



We have done our homework. Every page has a suggested copy draft, section-by-section layout direction, brand color palette, voice and context documents, site architecture, and SEO requirements all prepared and waiting for you.



The copy is a strong starting point, not a paste-and-publish draft. We need someone with strong English writing skills and real conversion copywriting ability to review, refine, and rewrite where needed so every section speaks directly to our target audience and drives them to take action. If you can design and write, you are exactly who we are looking for. If design is your strength and writing is not, this is not the right fit. 



You are not starting from scratch. You are taking a thoroughly planned site and making it both beautiful and sharp enough to convert. 





WHAT WE ARE BUILDING



Modern, and clean. Warm and personal, not cold corporate. Think SaaS company aesthetic with a human side. Conversion focused above everything else. Beautiful design matters. When design and conversion conflict, conversion wins. 



The site must be built natively in GHL with full edit controls on every element. Code is welcome for enhancing specific visual details and animations but the foundation must be native GHL, not a code block drop-in. We want to be able to edit content after you leave without touching code. 



Fully mobile responsive. Tested before delivery. Not optional.





COMPENSATION AND TIMELINE



$5 per hour, $300 project maximum. We estimate 40 hours for a designer who knows GHL well and can write. Phase one live as fast as you can professionally deliver it. Full project complete by end of July.





WHO THIS IS FOR



You have built real multi-page GHL websites with navigation, service pages, and clear design intent behind them. You write well in English and understand how copy, layout, and visual hierarchy work together to move someone from curious to converted. You know the difference between copy that sounds good and copy that actually gets people to act. You work well from a detailed brief without heavy hand-holding. 





HOW TO APPLY

s

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist (Stripe Billing + QuickBooks) for US Marketing Agency
description:
Own the billing and collections for a US marketing agency. If you're an experienced AR or bookkeeping professional who likes being the person everyone trusts with the money, this is your seat.



ABOUT US



RoofIgnite is a US-focused marketing agency. We run Meta advertising for roofing contractors doing $2.5M or more per year, and we're part of the 
 portfolio. We're a small, tight remote team, and almost all of our team is based in the Philippines, so you'll be in good company.



Our clients pay us a monthly retainer. The work is good and the clients stay. The one gap we have is on our own books: billing goes out late because nobody on the team has the time to run it on a strict schedule. That delay costs us real money every month. We want one reliable person to take full ownership of it so it never slips again.





THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE



You make sure every client is billed correctly and on time, you chase down anything that's late or failed, and you keep our books clean in QuickBooks.



This is a high-trust role. You will have direct control over the company's incoming cash, working closely with the two owners. We're looking for someone who treats accuracy and follow-through as a point of pride.





WHAT YOUR WEEK ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE



Most of your time, the core of the job:



Billing in Stripe.

When the team tells you a client is ready to be charged, you create and send the charge in Stripe right away. This is manual and on purpose, we don't auto-bill, because we confirm with each client first. It's roughly 60 to 70 charges a month, usually $3,500 to $5,000 each, some larger. You own the billing calendar so nothing is ever late.



Collections.

When a payment fails or a client goes quiet, you run the follow-up. You'll work from a dedicated 
 address and you'll
 and call US clients directly. The escalation path is clear: friendly reminder, firm follow-up, phone call, flag to leadership if a service pause is needed, then final notice. Often a failed payment just needs someone to get the client on the phone and sort out a new card. That someone is you.



Recovering overdue accounts.

Some accounts go past due (we count that as a missed billing cycle, or 14 or more days late with no reply). You take those on and recover them.



Reporting.

You keep the owners updated on what's late, what's at risk, and what you've recovered, so we always know where our cash stands.



A smaller, steady part of the job:



QuickBooks bookkeeping.

You categorize expenses in QuickBooks. The rules and SOPs already exist and most transactions sort themselves automatically. You handle the ones that don't (roughly 500 to 600 a month) and send anything unusual for approval. You're running the system we built, not building it.



Data quality checks.

You audit two of our Google Sheets (a B2B sales tracker and a client check-in sheet) for missing or incomplete information, then track down the correct data and fill the gaps. Example: a lead marked "set and confirmed" while the "setter qualified" field is blank. You catch it and fix it.



Keeping an eye on the numbers.

You watch our key sales and marketing figures and flag anything that looks off.



Occasionally:



Helping onboard new hires in BambooHR, as needed. This is light and infrequent.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



This role only works for a specific kind of person, so please read honestly.



You need two strengths that don't always come together: real precision with numbers, and the confidence to chase money without backing down. Plenty of people have one. The careful ones can be too soft to push a late payer. The pushy ones miss the small errors that make an invoice wrong. We need both in the same person.



You should have:



- 2 or more years in accounts receivable, bookkeeping, or collections (more is welcome).

- Real, hands-on Stripe and QuickBooks experience. Not "I've seen it," but "I've run it."

- Fluent English, written and spoken. You'll represent us to US clients by
 and phone, so both matter.

- A steady, organized approach to deadlines. You're the kind of person who keeps a list and works it.



Nice to have (not required): GoHighLevel, ClickUp, BambooHR, and strong Google Sheets skills.





HOURS AND PAY



Full-time, EST business hours. That's a night shift in the Philippines, roughly 9pm to 6am your time. Where you live doesn't matter as long as you work those hours reliably.



Base pay is $1,500 to $1,700 USD per month depending on experience. On top of that, you earn performance bonuses tied to things like overdue accounts recovered, on-time collection, and clean, accurate data. Do the job well and you earn more.



This is an immediate hire. We want to bring someone on as soon as we find the right fit.





BEFORE YOU APPLY: COMPLETE THE BILLING ACCURACY CHECK



Every applicant must complete this short billing accuracy check. It's a real sample of the work:







Completing it is required, not optional.



To prove you read this whole post, start your application with the word LEDGER.



Any application that skips the test, skips the LEDGER keyword, or doesn't include a recording will not be considered for an interview. This is a firm requirement.





HOW TO APPLY



Along with starting your message with LEDGER, send a recording. This is required, not optional. Use Loom video or any application/software that shares your face and screen at the same time.



In your recording, cover:



1. Your name and where you're based.

2. Your accounts receivable, billing, and collections experience.

3. The tools you've actually used hands-on.

4. Your answers to the three questions inside the billing accuracy check: which rows have an incorrect Total Charged and the correct amount for each, what went wrong in each case (a fee added that shouldn't be there, a fee missing, or the ad spend math), and what you'd check before sending the invoice.



Only applicants who complete the check and send a recording will be considered for an interview. No recording, no interview.



We also use the recording to hear your spoken English and get a feel for your personality, since this role talks to clients. So speak clearly and naturally, and just be yourself.

title: Ads Copywriter / Creative Strategist (Direct Response, DTC Health)
description:
We are a direct-to-consumer health brand running cold paid traffic on Meta.



We are hiring a Creative Strategist, not a video editor.



This role is for someone who can figure out what ads we should make next.



You will be responsible for coming up with hooks, angles, scripts, static ad concepts, and landing page ideas based on customer research and ad performance data.



We already have people who can help with video editing and production...



What we need is someone who can think strategically, study the market, understand the customer, and create concepts that can become winning ads.



Apply here: 



Your main job:



- Look at ad performance data and figure out what is working, what is failing, and why

- Study winning ads, competitors, customer reviews, comments, forums, and buyer language

- Create new ad concepts for Meta

- Write video ad scripts with strong hooks and clear angles

- Create static/image ad ideas with copy and visual direction

- Help with landing page or advertorial copy when needed



This is not a media buying role. We handle campaign structure, budgets, bids, and scaling in-house.



This is not a pure video editing role. If your main skill is cutting clips, adding captions, transitions, music, and b-roll, this is probably not the right role unless you also know how to create strong direct response ad concepts.



A strong person in this role can take a product, study the customer, look at the data, and come back with specific ads we should test next.



For example, you should be able to say:



- This hook is working because it calls out the exact symptom

- This ad is getting attention but losing people after the first 5 seconds

- This competitor angle is worth testing, but we should make it more specific

- Customers keep mentioning this objection, so we should make an ad around it

- This winning concept should be turned into 5 new variations



You will work directly with the founder, who handles strategy and media buying. You will also work with a video editor and VA team who can help execute the ideas you create.



Our stack includes Meta Ads, Funnelish, Klaviyo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT, Claude, and AI image/video tools.



You need to be comfortable using AI tools to move faster. We use AI to speed up production, but the strategy, ideas, hooks, and angles still need to be sharp.



You are probably a good fit if you think in hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, customer psychology, and testing loops.



You are probably not a good fit if you mainly want to be handed footage and told what to edit.



We move fast, test constantly, and care about results. No busywork. No clock-watching. Just the work, the data, and the next idea.



If you can consistently create strong ad concepts that turn into profitable tests, this role can grow into more responsibility, more ownership, and more pay.

title: Personal  Injury Case Manager
description:

Our firm handles personal injury cases throughout Louisiana. We are investing heavily in systems, technology, and case development. We want tea
mbers who take ownership, solve problems, and help us deliver exceptional service to our clients.



---

* Take initiative without waiting to be told every next step

* Stay organized while managing multiple active cases

* Communicate professionally with clients, providers, and insurance companies

* Notice when a file is missing information

* Follow through consistently

* Think critically about what needs to happen next

* Enjoy solving problems

* Learn technology quickly

* Want to improve and grow professionally



We do not need someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



We need someone who can help move cases forward.



---



## WHAT YOU'LL DO



You will help manage personal injury cases from the time a client signs with the firm until the case resolves.



Your responsibilities may include:



### Client Communication



* Communicate regularly with clients regarding case status

* Answer client questions and concerns

* Request information and documentation from clients

* Keep clients informed throughout the life of the case

* Follow up with clients who become unresponsive



### Medical Records & Treatment Management



* Request medical records and billing records

* Track treatment progress

* Follow up with medical providers

* Monitor gaps in treatment

* Identify missing records or outstanding documentation

* Maintain accurate medical timelines



### Insurance & Case Development



* Communicate with insurance adjusters

* Confirm policy information

* Assist with claim documentation

* Track settlement negotiations

* Assist with demand package preparation



### Case Management



* Maintain organized electronic files

* Update Pipedrive and internal systems

* Monitor deadlines and important milestones

* Identify files that have stalled

* Escalate issues that require attorney attention

* Help ensure that no case falls through the cracks



---



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Six months from now:



* Clients receive timely updates

* Records are obtained quickly

* Cases move efficiently through the pipeline

* Deadlines are not missed

* Files remain organized and current

* Problems are identified before attorneys discover them

* The team trusts you to manage your cases effectively



Most importantly:



You are helping move cases toward resolution instead of waiting for someone else to tell you what to do next.



---



## TECHNOLOGY



We embrace technology, automation, and AI to help us serve clients better.



You do not need AI experience, but you should be comfortable learning new systems and adapting to new workflows.



People who enjoy technology tend to do well here.





## REQUIREMENTS



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Reliable internet connection

* Quiet workspace

* Ability to work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time

* Strong organizational skills

* Strong attention to detail



Experience in any of the following is a plus:



* Personal Injury Law

* Insurance Claims

* Medical Records Management

* Legal Case Management

* Customer Service



## APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A short video introducing yourself.

3. Tell us which personal injury software, CRMs, or case management systems you have used.

US Bookkeeping Experience

US Tax Knowledge

Excel / Google Sheets

title: AUSTIN REALTOR HIRING: Lead Gen Expert Who Can Book 20 IN-PERSON Appointments/Week
description:
I'll be blunt — I've read 50 proposals from people claiming to be lead gen experts. Most of them copy-paste the same answer. I'm not interested in that.



I'm a full-time Realtor in Austin, Texas and I'm looking for one person who has actually done this before — someone who can build me a repeatable system that books 20 face-to-face appointments per week with real buyers and sellers.



Not phone calls. Not Zoom. In person. Confirmed. Showing up.



---



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL ROLE.



If you haven't generated leads for Realtors, wholesalers, investors, or real estate teams that turned into actual closed deals — please don't apply. I will verify your experience.



---



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU IN YOUR PROPOSAL:



Don't just tell me you can do it. Show me your plan. I want to see:



1. Have you done this before? How many years? What markets?

2. What's your exact strategy to get me to 20 in-person appointments per week in Austin, TX?

3. What lists would you target and why?

4. What systems and software would you use? (You manage the CRM — not me.)

5. What are realistic startup costs and monthly budget?

6. What should I expect at 30, 60, and 90 days — in actual appointment numbers?

7. What does this cost me per month for your time?

8. Prove it — show me a past result. Appointments booked, deals closed, whatever you've got.

9. How many other people do we need to hire



I want something OUTSIDE of the box



The candidate who gives me a specific, detailed plan wins. Vague answers get ignored.



---



SCOPE OF WORK:

- Build and manage the full lead gen system (you own the CRM and follow-up)

- Target buyers and sellers in Austin, TX and surrounding 20-mile radius

- Book confirmed, face-to-face appointments directly onto my calendar

- Ongoing optimization and reporting



Budget is open for the right person with the right plan.



If you've built this before and you're confident you can do it again — I want to hear from you.

title: Full-Stack Developer — Luxury Childcare Platform (Supabase, Stripe, Integrations)
description:
Full-Stack Developer — Luxury Childcare Platform (Supabase, Stripe, Integrations)



Job type: Full-time for the build phase, then a part-time retainer for maintenance and scaling

Hours: Full-time during the build, with a few hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time

Compensation: Competitive, monthly in USD, by experience (range at the bottom)

Start date: Immediately





About us



We are House of Nannies, a luxury domestic-staffing agency serving New York, Connecticut, New Jersey, and the Hamptons. We are launching Little Minders, an on-demand sitter membership, and we run our operations on our own internal platform, The Nest.



The Nest is already fully designed, end to end — every screen, flow, and rule has been worked out and documented. We have a complete set of reference designs (heirloom-styled HTML), a written rulebook for how profiles and matching work, role-versioned contracts, settings/taxonomy, and clear build tasks. We know exactly what we want. We need a strong developer to implement it faithfully, ship it, and then maintain and scale it.



This is a real product, with real families and real money moving through it. We care about reliability, a calm and beautiful user experience, and doing things properly.



The stack





Front end: HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript (single-file pages today; you may propose a sensible framework if it speeds delivery without bloating)

Back end: Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Row-Level Security, Edge Functions)

Hosting: Netlify

Payments: Stripe (membership billing in use; Stripe Connect + invoicing to build)

Already integrated: Google Calendar two-way sync; an AI résumé-parsing edge function

AI: we use AI for résumé parsing and profile generation (the rules are documented)





You inherit a working codebase and a complete design package — reference HTML for every screen, a build-task list, an AI profile rulebook, contract templates, and written business rules. You're building from clear specs, not a blank page.



What you'll build (from our designs and specs)



Communications & notifications





An in-app messaging inbox (candidate ? team, family ? team) — currently our biggest gap

Browser/desktop notifications + sound (Web Notifications API + service worker for closed-app push)

A persistent badge that reflects a count of outstanding items and clears only when everything's handled (not on a single click)





Profiles & matching (from the rulebook)





Role-matched profiles: a candidate can hold multiple roles (nanny, newborn care specialist, housekeeper, personal assistant, family assistant); the family sees the profile matched to the role applied for

Redaction at the data/RPC layer: references, last name (until offer), "why a role ended" (internal), and graduation year are hidden in the data, not just the UI

A multi-role application input where a candidate fills capabilities per role, feeding the matched profile

A configurable Settings · Lists taxonomy (tags, types, statuses + sub-statuses, availability, at-a-glance fields). It must import and preserve our existing data — never wipe it.





Contracts & e-signature





Generate the agreement from the role + the family's children/intake + the accepted offer (duties are produced per placement)

In-platform e-signature (we do NOT use SignWell) that captures an audit trail: signer, IP address, date/timestamp, device as the signature certificate

Contract states: internal draft / client draft (legal-review flags visible to the family, never to the candidate) / clean signed version (flags disappear); archive a timestamped disclaimer copy for the record

A separate independent-contractor agreement type for newborn care specialists





Payments — Stripe





Embedded card capture (Stripe Elements) — families pay inside the platform, card on file, no redirect

Stripe Connect: sitter onboarding so sitters receive payouts; auto-route cancellation/rush fees, bonuses, and reimbursements to the right sitter

Membership billing (tiers, overage, low-credit handling)

Placement fees invoiced via Stripe Invoicing, collected by ACH bank debit (not card) to avoid high fees on large amounts

A deposit step at client activation





Little Minders booking





Booking-request flow (notify matching sitters, favorites first ? interest ? family confirms ? contact released only after confirmation)

Tokenized no-login links with redaction enforced at the database layer (RLS / security-definer functions)

Rush/short-notice priority queue; reliability scoring per sitter

Sitter onboarding: background check (we add the sitter's
 in the provider portal), CPR upload, references, evaluations





Workflow & internal tools





A merged Tasks & Routines tab: personal daily routines + tasks (private per user) and a shared team to-do list (claim ? "working on it" with assignee ? "completed by")

Calendar wired to family + candidate portals (per-member read-only OAuth)

Job board status synced to search stage with manual override

A Resources tab (internal vs. client), with internal resources view-only/no-download, and resources auto-tagged to a client's profile based on their situation

Records page, recycle bin/soft-delete, stage history & audit logging (largely designed)





Integrations (bigger lifts)





: a transactional + marketing service (Resend / Postmark / SendGrid) — redesigned stage-based templates and segmented blasts

Video in-platform for interviews; AI transcripts attached to the right candidate record

(Done already: a VideoAsk link for the Fast Track intro step)





Mobile apps — App Store & Google Play





Publish the platform to both stores (e.g., wrapping the web app with Capacitor), with push notifications

Configure payments to pass store review (our memberships pay for a real-world service, generally exempt from Apple IAP — Stripe must stay within guidelines)





Quality & scale





Fast, smooth, simple. Clean schema, proper indexing, no hard cap on users. Documented, maintainable code.





Required experience





Strong JavaScript and front-end development

Supabase or Postgres — Auth, Row-Level Security, SQL, Edge/serverless functions

Stripe — especially Stripe Connect (payouts, transfers, webhooks), plus Elements, Invoicing, and ACH debit. Essential.

REST APIs and webhooks; comfortable integrating third-party services end to end

Good written English and a few hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time





Nice to have





Two-sided marketplace / platform experience

Publishing to the App Store and Google Play (Capacitor, React Native, or PWA-to-app)

-service, video SDK (Zoom / Daily / Whereby), and AI / speech-to-text (Whisper / Deepgram / AssemblyAI) integration

Netlify, Google Calendar API, or AI/LLM experience





How we work





Milestone-based delivery with clear scope and check-ins. Build additively — we have an existing platform and live data; never wipe it.

We'll point you at our design package first; you'll start with one piece and show us before building the rest.

All code and IP belong to us; you'll sign an NDA and confidentiality/IP agreement (we handle sensitive family information).

You get scoped, least-privilege access; you won't handle raw card data (Stripe's hosted flows do).





To apply, please send:





A short note on your experience with Stripe Connect and Supabase specifically

One or two examples of platforms or payment integrations you've built (links if possible)

Your monthly rate for full-time work and your availability to start

To show you read this, start your message with the word "Quatrefoil."

We extract a coach’s entire content library, build a structured knowledge base from it, and deploy a voice-enabled conversational AI agent that responds in the coach’s voice so their high-ticket clients get instant answers between coaching sessions without the coach lifting a finger.

We’re building something real and we want someone who wants to grow with it.



About the Project: Your first project is building a complete conversational AI voice agent and RAG pipeline for a fitness influencer with two-plus years of YouTube content. The agent needs to be voice queryable with low latency audio responses clients speak to it naturally and get responses in the coach’s voice within seconds.



What You’ll Build:

 • YouTube transcript ingestion pipeline using youtube-transcript-api and Whisper API

 • Vector knowledge base in Supabase pgvector with HNSW indexing

 • Python-based chunking and embedding pipeline using OpenAI text-embedding-3-small or Voyage AI

 • RAG retrieval pipeline with cosine similarity dense search first, hybrid BM25 sparse search ready for V2

 • Claude API integration with custom system prompt engineering for voice and personality matching

 • Mem0 memory layer for cross-session client continuity and long term context

 • Real-time voice pipeline Deepgram STT for speech to text, ElevenLabs streaming TTS for low latency audio responses

 • n8n workflow orchestration connecting all pipeline components

 • Branded web app frontend voice recording interface, audio playback, user authentication, mobile responsive generated via Claude Code and integrated into the pipeline

 • End to end voice latency optimization to under 3 seconds from input to audio response



Required Skills:

 • Python — strong proficiency, clean production-ready code

 • RAG pipeline architecture chunking strategy, embeddings, vector retrieval, context injection

 • Vector databases Supabase pgvector or Pinecone, hands-on production experience

 • Claude API or OpenAI API — direct API integration experience, not just wrapper tools

 • Voice pipeline — Deepgram STT, Whisper API, ElevenLabs streaming TTS

 • n8n — workflow automation, API chaining, webhook handling

 • Mem0 or equivalent memory layer — cross-session context management

 • REST API integration — webhooks, async handling, error management

 • LangChain or LlamaIndex — production pipeline experience preferred

 • Supabase — database setup, pgvector configuration, query optimization

 • Claude Code or AI-assisted development — proficiency strongly preferred

 • Web app deployment — hosting, environment configuration, domain setup



Nice to Have:

 • BM25 hybrid search implementation

 • Langfuse or LangSmith RAG monitoring and tracing

 • Twilio WhatsApp API integration

 • Conversational AI agent development for real clients

 • Voice cloning pipeline experience

 • ElevenLabs Professional Voice Cloning

 • React or Next.js frontend experience



Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field required. Master’s degree preferred.



Work Style: This is a fully async remote role. You set your own hours and work when you’re most productive. No night shifts, no US timezone requirements. Responsive within 4-6 hours during your chosen working hours. We don’t require US timezone availability but we do expect timely communication and proactive updates on progress. Weekly check-in call at a mutually agreed time. We care about output and delivery — not when you’re online.



Growth Path: For the right person this role has a clear and well-compensated advancement path:

 • Phase 1 — Project-based AI Engineer. Prove your skills on the first build. $1,000 fixed.

 • Phase 2 — Full-time Senior AI Engineer. Own all client builds at $1,200-1,500/month.

 • Phase 3 — Lead AI Engineer. Hire, onboard, and manage our growing developer team as we scale to multiple clients per month. $2,500-3,000/month.

Compensation scales as the business grows. We take care of the people who take care of us. If you want to build a career not just complete projects — this is the opportunity.



What We’re Looking For:

Someone who has actually built and shipped RAG pipelines and conversational AI voice agents in production — not just completed courses. We need someone who can take a technical spec and execute independently without hand-holding.

Production experience is required. Please do not apply if you have only completed courses or personal projects.

Please include:

 • Links to GitHub repos or live production projects

 • A short Loom video (5-10 minutes) walking through a relevant RAG pipeline or voice agent you built

 • Brief description of your specific experience with real-time voice pipelines

 • Answer this question in your application: “Describe how you would handle chunk overlap in a RAG pipeline and why it matters for retrieval quality”

Applications without a Loom video, GitHub portfolio, and answer to the technical question will not be considered.



Project Scope and Timeline:

 • Week 1 — Content ingestion pipeline and knowledge base live

 • Week 2 — RAG retrieval and Claude API clone core complete

 • Week 3 — Voice pipeline integrated and latency optimized

 • Week 4 — Web app frontend deployed, revisions complete, handoff

 • You must be able to dedicate 20+ hours per week to this project



Milestone Payment Structure via Deel Escrow:

 • $400 released — Knowledge base live and retrieving correctly

 • $400 released — Voice pipeline end to end working under 3 seconds

 • $200 released — Web app deployed and final delivery approved by Empire42

All payments processed through Deel milestone-based escrow. Please only apply if you are comfortable with this payment structure.



What Success Looks Like:

 • RAG pipeline retrieves accurate relevant chunks for any client query

 • Conversational AI voice agent responds in the coach’s voice, tone, and frameworks

 • End to end voice latency consistently under 3 seconds

 • Mem0 memory layer correctly recalls client context across sessions

 • Escalation logic triggers correctly on sensitive or off-limits topics

 • Branded web app is live, mobile responsive, and client-ready

 • Coach personally approves the clone as an accurate representation of their brand



To Apply:

Send your application with:

 1 Loom video walkthrough of a RAG pipeline or voice agent you built in production

 2 GitHub or portfolio links showing relevant projects

 3 Brief paragraph on your real-time voice pipeline experience — Deepgram, Whisper, ElevenLabs

 4 Your weekly availability in hours

 5 Answer to the technical screening question above

title: Organic Sales Representative
description:
We’re building an organic sales team to drive revenue for a health and supplements line through platforms like TikTok, X 
), and Reddit.



This is not a traditional social media role.

This is a performance-driven role focused on creating content, generating traffic, and converting attention into sales.

We provide proven hooks, angles, and direction—but we also expect you to contribute ideas, test variations, and help scale what works.



Important:

All content is targeted toward the US market, so understanding US tone, language, and audience behavior is critical.



What You’ll Do:

-Create 5–10 pieces of content daily across TikTok, X, Reddit, and other platforms

-Execute on provided hooks, scripts, and content frameworks

-Contribute your own ideas and variations

-Test different delivery styles, hooks, and messaging

-Drive traffic to our funnel (link-in-bio)

-Track views, clicks, and sales



Weekly Content Planning (Important):

-You will create a simple weekly content plan to stay aligned with brand direction.

-This is NOT a corporate content calendar.



It should include:

-Key angles/hooks you plan to test

-Content themes for the week (e.g., energy, wellness, lifestyle)

-Variations based on previous performance

-Planning should be fast, practical, and execution-focused.



Content Style (Critical):

This audience responds to:

-Relatable, experience-based content

-Lifestyle and wellness storytelling

-Honest, non-salesy delivery

-You should sound like a real person sharing what worked—not a brand or a salesperson.



Content Approach:

You will:

-Use provided hooks and frameworks

-Add your own voice and variations

-Continuously test and improve performance



Compensation:

Base: $200–$300/month (starting)

4hrs a day

Sunday & Saturday Rest day



Commission Structure:

$10 per sale

+$5 for each rebill (up to 2 rebills per order)

???? Total potential:

Up to $20 commission per sale

Tiered incentives for higher performance



Requirements:

-Must have existing social media accounts on TikTok, X 
), Instagram, or
 that you can use for organic posting

-Must be able to create and post content targeting the US market

-Comfortable creating content (on-camera or written)

-Able to execute quickly and consistently

-Can follow direction AND contribute ideas

-Organized enough to plan weekly content



You Might Be a Fit If:

-You’ve created content on TikTok or similar platforms

-You understand what gets attention and engagement

-You can take a script and make it feel natural

-You are proactive and performance-driven



You’re NOT a Fit If:

-You over-plan instead of executing

-You focus on aesthetics over results

-You move slowly or need constant direction

-You’re looking for a passive or low-output role



Paid Trial Process (1 Week):

-All candidates will go through a 1-week paid trial.



During the trial, you will:

-Receive hooks, scripts, and direction

-Create daily content

-Submit a simple weekly content plan

-Test your own variations



Goal:

Generate at least 1 sale (ideal, not required)



We evaluate:

-Execution

-Content quality

-Consistency

-Initiative

-Top performers will be offered a long-term role.



Performance Assessment (Monthly):

All tea
mbers are evaluated on a monthly basis.



Assessment is based on:

-Content output and consistency

-Engagement and traffic generated

-Sales performance

-Initiative and ability to improve results



Quota & Expectations:

-This is a performance-based role with clear expectations.

-Each rep is expected to:

-Maintain consistent daily output

-Contribute to revenue generation

-Work toward monthly sales targets

-Specific quota benchmarks will be discussed during onboarding and adjusted based on performance and ramp period.

-Consistent underperformance may result in removal from the team.



To Apply:

Share links to your social media accounts



Answer this:

“If we gave you a hook, how would you turn it into multiple pieces of content AND what variation would you test to improve performance?”



Be specific. Generic answers will not be considered.



This is a performance-based role with real upside.

If you’re looking for a traditional job, this is not it.

If you want to execute, test, and get paid based on results—apply.

title: Shopify Store Operator / Online Business Manager (Build + Run a New Brand)
description:
We're launching a new preparedness e-commerce and content brand serving Australia and the United States. The website, ~75 products, and content plan are already designed and written. We need one capable, self-directed person to **take it live in Shopify and then run it day-to-day** — so the owner can stay in a light strategic role.



This is not a basic data-entry VA role. You'll own the operation and make sensible decisions without being handed a daily task list.



**Phase 1 — Launch (first 4–6 weeks):**

- Build the store in Shopify from supplied design files (13 finished pages)

- Set up two markets (AU + US) using Shopify Markets, connect the domain (already owned)

- Load ~75 products into two collections, tagged correctly (in-stock / backorder / affiliate)

- Configure payments, tax, shipping, and geo-targeted affiliate links (Lasso or 
)

- Connect an
 tool + lead-magnet guides; coordinate legal-page review



**Phase 2 — Run it (ongoing, ~20 hrs/week):**

- Process orders, manage a small seed inventory, coordinate fulfilment and returns

- Publish content from our existing SEO plan (AI-assisted drafting is encouraged)

- Keep affiliate links and prices current; add/retire products as demand shows

- Answer customer enquiries in a calm, honest brand voice

- Watch for demand spikes (weather events, supply disruptions) and act fast

- Report to the owner in a 45-minute weekly meeting with decisions pre-framed



**You must have:**

- Hands-on Shopify experience (built or run a real store)

- Fluent, natural written English in a calm, trustworthy tone

- Comfort using AI tools for content and operations

- Self-direction — you own outcomes, not just tasks

- Reliable overlap with AU business hours



**Nice to have:** Shopify Markets / multi-region, affiliate marketing (
), basic SEO, e-commerce customer service,
 marketing tools.



**TO APPLY (please follow exactly — this is how we shortlist):**

1. Start your message with the phrase **"Prepped and ready"**

2. In 2–3 sentences, tell us about a Shopify store you built or ran and what your role was

3. Answer this: *A customer
s saying they bought a water filter from us but realise they actually live in an apartment and think they bought the wrong thing. How would you reply?*

4. One line: how would you use AI tools to run a small store efficiently?

5. State your expected monthly rate for ~20 hrs/week (in AUD or USD).



Applications that don't follow these four steps won't be considered. We value clarity and judgment over long cover letters.
salary: c.50000-60000 PHP per mth depending exp.

.

nts. Good visual judgment is important. You should be able to tell when a video looks funny, realistic, weird in a good way, or unusable.



You do NOT need to be a professional video editor. But you must be comfortable using AI tools, uploading videos, following instructions, and making good content-quality decisions.



Expected output:

- 3 finished/scheduled videos per day

- Around 1-2 hours of work per day

- Part-time, long-term role if the trial goes well



Requirements:

- Strong attention to detail

- Good taste for short-form TikTok / Reels / Shorts style content

- Comfortable using AI tools

- Reliable internet

- Able to follow SOPs exactly

- Able to work independently without constant supervision

- Basic English reading/writing

- Experience with YouTube Shorts, TikTok,
,  + AI video creators like Sora, google Geo, Wan AI tools is a plus

We care more about taste, reliability, and consistency than a fancy resume.

, or Instagram before?

title: Channel Partner Manager
description:
We are looking for a results-driven, high-energy Channel Partner Manager based in the Philippines to re-ignite and scale our global Channel Partnership Programme. This is a full time, remote role.



Our partnership model is unique and highly attractive: we offer a "Zero Sales Burden" proposition. Your partners do not need to learn complex software demonstrations or close technical deals; their sole focus is identifying opportunities, introducing our platform, and registering qualified leads. Once a lead is registered, our internal sales team takes over to run the demos and close the revenue, while the partner reaps the rewards.



Your mission is to find the right partners, onboard them quickly, and keep them highly engaged so they consistently feed our sales pipeline with high-quality opportunities.



Key Responsibilities

Re-ignite & Scale: Audit our existing partner network, re-engage dormant relationships, and design a structured outreach strategy to recruit new high-potential channel partners.



Partner Enablement & Activation: Equip partners with the simple tools, messaging, and co-marketing materials they need to easily identify leads within their existing networks.



Pipeline & Lead Governance: Actively manage the partner lead registration portal. Review incoming leads to ensure quality, prevent market conflicts, and smoothly hand them off to our internal account executives.



Relationship Management: Serve as the primary, day-to-day point of contact for partners. Run regular check-ins to keep our SaaS top-of-mind and help them overcome any roadblocks.



Performance Tracking: Monitor partner-driven pipeline metrics (lead volume, conversion rates, and partner activity levels) and report directly to leadership on programme health.



Required Qualifications & Experience

SaaS Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of experience specifically managing or scaling a Channel Partnership / Reseller / Referral Programme for a B2B SaaS company.



Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success in driving predictable, high-volume lead registration or indirect revenue growth through third-party partners.



Excellent Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to confidently pitch, negotiate, and build trust with business owners and channel executives globally.



Process & Tool Savvy: Comfortable managing partner portals, CRMs (e.g., HubSpot/Salesforce), and leveraging automation tools to track lead attribution accurately.



Self-Starter Mindset: Experience working remotely for international companies. You are highly organized, comfortable with ambiguity, and capable of executing a partnership strategy with minimal day-to-day supervision.

You’ll be part of the engine that keeps our day-to-day running smoothly - supporting our customers, organizing backend operations, and helping us improve how we work as we scale.

Your Role

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for Hair Etc., a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, run a proven script, and book them onto the salon's calendar.



If you're a sales-oriented setter who loves high-volume work, runs scripts the way they were written, and is motivated by performance pay tied to real results — keep reading. If you want a low-pressure customer service job or you like "making the script your own," this won't be a fit.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on Hair Etc., a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You can see the salon directly:



- Google Maps Listing: share.google/iX1SgvUhBw386WHHg

- Instagram: 
/hairetcfontana/



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at Hair Etc. handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script word-for-word for the entire call, from greeting to booking. The only time you go off-script is to answer a client's specific question (directions, timing) or collect unique info.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We say "word-for-word" because that's how the role works — but we want to clear up the most common concern people have about that:



"Won't I sound like a robot if I'm reading a script?"



No. Think about the best actors in your favorite movies. They're saying lines someone else wrote. They don't sound robotic because they've rehearsed enough that the words feel natural, and they bring real warmth, tone, and presence to the delivery. THAT'S EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE AFTER. The script is the structure. Your tone, pacing, and warmth are what make it feel human.



We train for this. You'll rehearse, get coached on tonality and pacing, and review your own call recordings until the words feel like yours — even though they're not. The setters who do this best sound like they're having a natural conversation that just happens to follow a proven path.



The script DOES change over time — but only based on data. If something isn't landing in calls, we test a new version, measure the results, and update the script if it works better. What we don't do is let setters freelance individual changes on the fly, because then we can't tell what's working and what's not.



If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll genuinely consider it. We'll A/B test it together. If the data shows it works better, it becomes the newscript. That's the structured way changes happen here.



If that framing works for you, you'll thrive. If "follow a script and let us measure what works" feels suffocating, this role won't be a fit.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



- Advanced English with minimal accent. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- Strong spoken communication — clear voice, confident on calls, doesn't ramble, not soft-spoken.

- Script discipline. You're comfortable running proven scripts word-for-word in mandatory parts of the call. (See the script section above for context on what this actually means day-to-day.)

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Process-oriented. You follow standardized workflows. If you want to change something, you bring a clear, data-backed suggestion to your manager and wait for a decision.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between July 13 – July 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | tally.so/r/rjGXZN?job_platform=OnlineJobs.ph |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

We value people who want long-term security and who take pride in their work. Our company has a strong history of working with Filipino staff, and we understand the value of loyalty, respect, and stable employment.



If you are looking for a serious long-term role with a growing Australian company, this may be the right position for you.

You will be joining a reputable company with more than 60 employees across multiple businesses. We already work with many Filipino tea
mbers, including staff who have been with us for over 10 years.

mber.

title: Organic Lead Generation Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Organic Lead Generation Specialist who can generate real buyer conversations through social platforms, communities, comments, and direct outreach.



This is not a basic social media posting role.



Your job is not just to create content. Your job is to find people who are already discussing relevant problems, join the conversation naturally, create interest, and move qualified prospects into a trackable lead path.



What You’ll Do



You will be responsible for finding and engaging potential buyers across platforms such as:



Reddit

Facebook Groups

TikTok comments

YouTube comments

X/Twitter

Forums

Niche online communities



Your main tasks will include:



Researching buyer-intent conversations online

Finding posts, comments, and threads where people are already asking questions or showing interest

Leaving useful, natural comments that contribute to the discussion

Starting conversations through replies and DMs without sounding spammy

Qualifying prospects based on problem, interest, urgency, and buying intent

Moving qualified leads to the correct profile, bridge page, landing page, or sales handoff

Tracking all activity, links, conversations, clicks, leads, and conversion signals daily

Testing different hooks, comment angles, platforms, and outreach styles

Reporting what is producing real conversations and buyer signals

What We’re Looking For



We need someone who is a hunter, not just a poster.



You should be able to:



Write strong, natural English

Sound like a real person in online communities

Understand how Reddit, Facebook groups, TikTok, YouTube comments, and X work

Identify buying intent from comments and discussions

Start conversations without sounding like a marketer

Follow daily activity targets

Track your work clearly

Think strategically about where buyers are hiding online

Adapt your messaging based on what gets responses

This Role Is Good For You If



You enjoy:



Searching online for active conversations

Commenting and replying naturally

Starting DMs and building conversations

Testing angles and seeing what gets traction

Working with clear daily targets

Turning organic activity into measurable leads

This Role Is NOT For You If



This is not a fit if you only know how to:



Schedule posts

Make Canva graphics

Write generic captions

Wait for people to engage

Copy-paste spammy comments

Say “check my link” everywhere

Report activity without producing leads



We are looking for someone who can create real opportunities, not just activity.



Daily Targets



You will be expected to hit daily activity and lead-generation targets such as:



Find 20+ relevant buyer-intent posts, threads, or comments

Leave 25–40 useful comments or replies

Start 10–15 conversations or DMs

Generate 3–5 qualified leads or strong buyer signals

Track clicks, replies, conversations, and lead quality daily

Weekly Success Metrics



Success in this role means:



Consistent qualified buyer conversations

Trackable clicks to profiles, bridge pages, or landing pages

Clear lead reports

Strong platform and angle testing

Sales opportunities passed to the team

Evidence that organic activity is creating real buyer interest

Requirements

Strong written English

Experience with organic outreach, community engagement, lead generation, or social selling

Familiarity with Reddit, Facebook Groups, TikTok, YouTube, and X

Ability to research and find buyer conversations manually

Comfortable with daily reporting

Able to work independently and hit targets

Must understand the difference between spam and natural engagement

How To Apply



Please answer the questions below:



What platforms have you used for organic lead generation?

How would you find people online who are already interested in a product before they ever see an ad?

Give an example of a natural comment you would leave on a post where someone is asking for product recommendations.

How would you move someone from a public comment into a DM without sounding spammy?

What would you track daily to prove that your work is producing leads?

Have you generated leads before through comments, DMs, groups, or communities? Explain your result.



Applications without answers to these questions will not be considered.
