title: Drafting Officer (Survey and Digital Delivery)
description:
About TA Project Services



TA Project Services Pty Ltd is an Australian consulting firm based in New South Wales, providing surveying, town planning, civil engineering, environmental, and project advisory services to clients across Australia.



We support a diverse range of development, infrastructure, and environmental projects and are committed to delivering practical, high-quality solutions through innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.



As part of our ongoing growth, we have established a dedicated Philippines-based support team that works closely with our Australian personnel across a range of technical and business functions. We are continuing to expand this capability and are seeking motivated professionals who are interested in developing their skills while contributing to Australian projects.



At TA Project Services, we value reliability, integrity, open communication, continuous learning, and a commitment to delivering quality outcomes for our clients.



Role Overview

The Drafting Officer (Survey) is responsible for providing survey drafting, survey processing, and digital production support to TA Project Services Pty Ltd.

The role focuses on survey drafting and technical support activities, including drawing preparation, CAD amendments, drafting updates, production drafting, survey data preparation, and pre-calculation support under the direction of Australian-based technical personnel.

The position is intended to support the development of TA Project Services' offshore technical services capability and provides a structured pathway into broader drafting, civil design support, GIS, and digital delivery functions as business requirements evolve.

The role contributes to efficient project delivery through the preparation of accurate, high-quality drafting outputs while supporting established drafting standards, procedures, and quality requirements.

The role supports TA Project Services' mission by delivering reliable, accurate, and efficient technical services while demonstrating the company's core values of efficiency, integrity, open communication, reliability, and continuous improvement.



Key Position Information

Salary Structure: Remote Technical Support

Reports To: Managing Director

Direct Reports: Nil

Mentor: Drafting & Digital Delivery Coordinator

Location: Philippines

Employment Type: Part-Time (Up to 15 Hours Per Week)

Collaborators: Drafting & Digital Delivery Coordinator, Survey Team, Civil Engineering Team, Town Planning Team 

Key Responsibilities

• Consistently act in accordance with TA Project Services’ core values. Demonstrate these values through decision-making, stakeholder engagement, teamwork, and the delivery of all work outcomes

Survey Drafting Support

• Prepare survey drafting deliverables under the direction of Australian-based personnel.

• Complete CAD amendments and drawing updates as instructed.

• Assist with preparation of plans, figures, maps, and survey-related documentation.

• Support production drafting activities for land development, planning, and infrastructure projects.

• Maintain drafting accuracy and consistency across project deliverables.

• Assist with conversion of field data into drafting outputs where required.

• Assist technical personnel with routine drafting and survey processing tasks.

• Support efficient preparation of plans and documentation through completion of pre-production activities.

Survey Processing and Pre-Calculation Support

• Assist with survey pre-calculation activities using established procedures and templates.

• Prepare supporting calculations, schedules, and project information for review by Australian-based technical personnel.

• Compile and organise survey data for drafting and project delivery purposes.

• Assist with processing field information and preparing data for drafting workflows.

• Maintain accuracy and consistency in all calculations and supporting project information.

• Escalate technical queries and anomalies for review where required.

• Support preparation of survey deliverables by completing routine technical processing tasks.

• Assist with document preparation and project data management activities.

Production Drafting

• Assist with drafting workloads across multiple projects.

• Prepare revisions and updates to existing drawings.

• Complete drafting tasks within agreed timeframes and quality requirements.

• Maintain organised project files and documentation.

• Support efficient delivery of project outputs.

• Ensure drafting outputs align with project instructions and established standards.

Quality Assurance and Standards Compliance

• Follow established drafting procedures, templates, and standards.

• Apply quality control checks before submitting completed work.

• Assist in maintaining consistency across drafting deliverables.

• Participate in drafting reviews and feedback processes.

• Implement improvements identified through QA/QC activities.

• Support the ongoing development of drafting libraries and templates.

Communication and Coordination

• Maintain regular communication with Australian-based tea
mbers.

• Provide updates regarding task progress and workload status.

• Seek clarification where project requirements are unclear.

• Participate in tea
etings and training activities as required.

• Participate in regular mentoring and capability development sessions with the Drafting & Digital Delivery Coordinator.

• Contribute to a collaborative and professional working environment.

Learning and Capability Development

• Develop knowledge of Australian surveying, planning, and infrastructure drafting requirements.

• Participate in training and capability development activities.

• Build competency in drafting software, standards, and digital delivery systems.

• Develop an understanding of survey calculations and technical workflows.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the drafting function.

• Develop capability for future involvement in civil drafting, GIS, and digital delivery activities.

________________________________________

Future Development Pathway

Subject to business requirements and demonstrated capability, the role may progressively expand to include:

Phase 1 – Initial Scope

• Survey drafting support.

• Survey data preparation and processing support.

• Survey pre-calculation support.

• CAD amendments.

• Production drafting.

• Drawing updates.

• Technical document preparation.

Phase 2 – Expanded Scope

• Basic civil drafting support.

• Plan presentation and graphical enhancement.

• Drawing package assembly.

• Standard detail integration.

• Additional drafting coordination activities.

Phase 3 – Mature Scope

• Civil drafting package support.

• GIS data preparation and mapping support.

• Digital model coordination activities.

• Broader digital delivery support.

• Advanced drafting and technical production activities.

________________________________________

Key Strengths of Ideal Applicant

• Strong understanding of surveying principles and spatial information.

• Strong drafting and CAD capability.

• Strong numerical aptitude and attention to detail.

• Ability to interpret survey information and technical documentation.

• Willingness to learn Australian surveying standards and workflows.

• Strong organisational and time management skills.

• Positive attitude and commitment to continuous improvement.

• Effective communication and collaboration skills.

• Ability to work independently within a remote team environment.

• Professional and reliable approach to work.

• Strong quality focus and commitment to meeting deadlines.

________________________________________

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

• Strong computer literacy and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills.

## The role



We are hiring a mid-level UAT tester on contract to be that last check. You will run user acceptance testing across our web and automation projects: confirming features do what the brief said, catching the breaks before clients do, and writing them up so a developer can fix them without a back-and-forth. You think like the end user, not like the person who built it.



## What you will do



- Read the brief or acceptance criteria, then turn them into clear, repeatable test cases.

- Run UAT across web apps, forms, dashboards, WhatsApp flows, and automation sequences.

- Test the full journey, not just the happy path: edge cases, bad input, broken links, mobile and desktop, different browsers.

- Verify integrations end to end (form to CRM, webhook to automation, payment confirmation, message delivery).

- Log defects clearly: steps to reproduce, expected vs actual, screenshots or recordings, severity.

- Re-test fixes and confirm nothing else broke (regression).

- Sign off on what is ready to ship, and be straight about what is not.

- Keep a tidy test record so we have evidence of what was checked.



## What we are looking for



- Two or more years in QA or UAT testing, ideally on web or SaaS products.

- Strong eye for detail. You notice the thing everyone else scrolled past.

- Able to write test cases and bug reports that a developer can act on without a call.

- Comfortable testing across browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

- Understands the difference between a bug, a missing requirement, and a design choice, and reports each correctly.

- Methodical and organised. You finish the checklist.

- Clear written English. You will work async, so your write-ups have to stand on their own.



## Nice to have



- Experience testing automation or chatbot flows (WhatsApp, 
, GoHighLevel, n8n, 
).

- Familiarity with a defect tracker (Asana, Jira, Notion, or similar).

- Basic API testing (Postman or similar) to check integrations directly.

- Some exposure to test automation tools, though this role is primarily manual UAT.



## How we work together



You will get the build, the acceptance criteria, and access to a defect tracker. We treat a well-written bug report as a gift, not a complaint. We would rather you flag ten things and have two turn out fine than miss the one that reaches the client. Honest sign-off is the whole job; never wave something through to keep the peace.



## To apply



Send a short note, your testing experience, and a sample bug report or test plan you have written (redacted is fine). Availability and rate expectations welcome up front.
